- High School Diploma or equivalent

JOB SUMMARY

This is an Operations position responsible for supervising the activities associated with Delivery. Responsibilities include but are not limited to, management and direction to delivery staff, compliance with government regulations and safety and security of the delivery department.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supervises the daily work and safety of Delivery Associates, including adherence to standard operating procedures, adherence to planned routes, and providing safe and efficient customer service.
  • Ensures Delivery Associate compliance with local, state and federal regulatory agencies (i.e. DOT, OSHA, etc.) and ensures that electronic logs are kept current and accurate.
  • Manages labor hours and consumable supplies within budget.
  • Prepares work schedules including extra work days and shifts as needed.
  • Oversees the proper selection utilization of company assets in support of the Delivery department.
  • Organizes required repairs with proper departments as necessary.
  • Reviews delivery functions and productivity reporting.
  • Suggests efficiency ideas, cost reduction measures and assists with implementation of delivery changes.
  • Interprets trains and consistently enforces Company policies, protocols and procedures including but not limited to food safety, DOT, record keeping, etc.
  • Communicates with Sales Management and Marketing Associates to collaboratively resolve any customer or delivery opportunities or issues.

  • Executes management functions of staff selection, development, discipline, performance reviews and/or terminations.
  • Performs the duties of associates supervised and other related duties as needed (and as qualified).

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • 2 or 4-year college degree in Business Management, Supply Chain Management or similar major preferred.

Experience

  • 1-3 years related experience and/or training.

Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations

  • Complete a Sysco approved defensive driving program.
  • HazMat certification preferred.
  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver License meeting Company standards preferred.

Professional Skills

  • Successfully engage and lead individual and team discussions and meetings.
  • Capable of working with peers and associates from other departments, operating companies, and Corporate proactively and constructively.
  • Solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Working knowledge of Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations.
  • Apply all relevant policies in a consistent, timely and objective manner.
  • Work in a disciplined manner and capable of following established procedures, practices and comply with local, state and federal regulations.
  • Manage the pressures and stress associated with a deadline-oriented atmosphere and customer service issues.

  • Able to read, analyze and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
  • Can write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
  • Effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Exhibit knowledge of spreadsheet software and Word Processing software, and ability to learn Sysco technology software and programs.
  • Must have excellent computer skills.
  • Ability to read, comprehends, write and speak English.
  • Can add, subtracts, multiply, and divides into all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Regularly required to talk or hear.
  • Frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and climb or balance.
  • Occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, push/pull up to 350 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Working Conditions

  • Occasionally exposed to wet, hot, extreme cold and/or humid conditions; and moving mechanical parts and may be required to work in confined spaces.
  • The associate works non-traditional business hours including evenings, nights, weekends, holidays and on-call.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
At our company, we translate strategy into running software. In this role, you will rapidly build functional prototypes (thin slices), validate them with users, and strengthen successful ones into scalable, stable services.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Development

  • Scope proof of concepts (PoC) from business intent with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver vertical thin slices across UI, API, data, and deployment layers.
  • Instrument usage, latency, and error tracking to validate ideas or terminate them quickly.
  • Evolve PoC into pilot and production stages through iterative hardening.
  • Align models with the business domain using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and bounded contexts.
  • Operate and maintain the services you build using CI, observability tools, and repeatable templates.

2. Ways of Working

  • Apply Agile principles with weekly demos and concise decision logs.
  • Use Systems Thinking to map workflows, identify constraints, and establish feedback loops.
  • Implement DDD to define clear domains and anti-corruption layers.
  • Focus on pragmatic 80/20 solutions that deliver measurable impact.
  • Document effectively with concise Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) and runnable readme-first repositories.
  • Design solutions with security, cost-efficiency, and least privilege in mind.
  • Communicate with structured, pyramid-style logic and clear so-what summaries for stakeholders.
  • Lead discovery sessions to define value hypotheses and leading metrics.
  • Translate business goals into architectural choices, highlighting trade-offs and total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Develop a roadmap that balances quick wins with long-term technical foundations.
  • Define service level objectives (SLOs), runbooks, and governance basics.
  • Advise on build-versus-buy decisions and support vendor evaluations with objective criteria.
  • Prepare client teams for success through comprehensive handover plans and checklists.l
  • Facilitate decision-making forums that surface risks, outline options, and determine next actions.

Preferred Technical Stack

  • Backend: FastAPI (Python), Node.js (as needed)
  • Frontend: React with utility-first CSS
  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, object storage, lightweight analytics tools
  • Cloud: Azure, GCP, AWS, or Alicloud (managed PaaS preferred)
  • DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), OpenTelemetry or equivalent observability tools

Qualifications

  • Proven experience delivering full-stack solutions from PoC to production.
  • Skilled at breaking down work into incremental deliverables and shipping weekly.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Systems Thinking, and DDD.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alicloud).
  • Excellent communication skills, especially when collaborating with product and domain stakeholders.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working with AI or machine learning models is a strong plus.

Title : Engineer – Patch Operations (Windows / Linux)
Experience Level: 1-3 Years

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Engineer to join our Patch Operations team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining operating system security compliance through vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, and platform lifecycle management across a large-scale hybrid infrastructure.

The role supports Windows and Linux server environments hosted across on-premises and multi-cloud platforms, ensuring security vulnerabilities are remediated within defined SLA timelines while maintaining platform stability and availability.

Our Environment

  • Enterprise-scale Windows and Linux server infrastructure

  • Multi-Cloud Platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Virtualization Platforms: Nutanix AHV and VMware vSphere

  • Patch Management Platform: Tanium

  • Vulnerability Management Tools: Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent

  • Infrastructure Automation: PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, Terraform

  • ITSM Platform: ServiceNow

  • Global 24x7 Operations Environment

Key Responsibilities

Patch Management & Remediation

  • Deploy monthly operating system security patches across Windows and Linux server environments.

  • Utilize Tanium to schedule, deploy, monitor, and validate patch compliance activities.

  • Coordinate emergency and Zero-Day vulnerability remediation activities.

  • Perform vulnerability remediation in accordance with organizational security policies and SLAs.

  • Validate successful installation of patches and security updates.

  • Investigate and resolve failed patch deployments.

Vulnerability Management

  • Analyze vulnerability reports and prioritize remediation activities based on risk ratings.

  • Collaborate with Cyber Security teams to address critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.

  • Track remediation progress and maintain compliance reporting.

Infrastructure Operations

  • Support Windows Server (2012, 2016, 2019, 2022) and Linux (RHEL, Rocky, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) environments.

  • Coordinate patching activities across Nutanix, VMware, AWS, Azure, and GCP hosted workloads.

  • Participate in maintenance windows and change management activities.

  • Support server lifecycle management activities including build, migration, and decommissioning.

  • Troubleshoot OS-related issues resulting from patch deployments.

Automation & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain PowerShell and Bash scripts to automate operational tasks.

  • Create and maintain patch compliance dashboards and reporting metrics.

  • Contribute to infrastructure automation initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to improve patching efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Operational Excellence

  • Participate in patch planning, scheduling, and execution meetings.

  • Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.

  • Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.

  • Support audit and compliance requirements related to security patching.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Experience managing Windows or Linux server environments.

  • Experience using enterprise patch management solutions such as Tanium, SCCM, BigFix, or equivalent.

  • Understanding of vulnerability management and remediation processes.

  • Knowledge of Windows Update or Linux package management, and security patching practices.

  • Familiarity with VMware vSphere and Nutanix AHV platforms.

  • Understanding of AWS, Azure, and GCP infrastructure concepts.

  • Experience with PowerShell and Bash scripting.

  • Knowledge of Active Directory and Windows Server administration (Windows Engineers).

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, Firewall, Load Balancing).

Operational Skills

  • Experience working in enterprise IT operations environments.

  • Understanding of Change Management and ITIL processes.

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex patching and vulnerability issues.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.

  • Experience with Tanium Patch Management or any other patching tool.

  • Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or Nessus would be an added advantage.

  • Familiarity with Azure Update Manager and AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager.

  • Experience supporting enterprise environments with 1,000+ servers would be an added advantage.

  • Microsoft, AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications (for Windows Engineers).

  • Red Hat, AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications (for Linux Engineers)

Benefits

  • Performance-based annual bonus

  • Performance rewards and recognition

  • Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

  • Paid birthday leave Team engagement allowance

  • Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

  • Hybrid work arrangement

title: Senior Software Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Senior Software Cybersecurity Engineer

Location: Uxbridge, UK (ZUK131), Edinburgh, UK (ZUK126)

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Avigilon security team, which you will be a key member of, is responsible for maintaining and implementing security controls for all confidential and intellectual property data across our physical security and video security platform, within the Avigilon organization.


Job Description

This role is hybrid, 2 days a week in our Uxbridge or Edinburgh offices.

The Senior Software Cybersecurity Engineer will analyze software designs and implementations to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities across the SDLC.

Please note Visa sponsorship is not provided for this particular opportunity.

Responsibilities

Security Design and Implementation

  • Perform threat modeling, risk assessments, audits, and architecture reviews, focusing on Cloud and container environments.
  • Manage Key Management and IAM controls.
  • Support engineering teams by defining security requirements to meet compliance standards and industry best practices.
  • Perform security code reviews and act as a technical SME for engineering and compliance teams.

Security Testing & DevSecOps

  • Deploy and manage automated security tools (SCA/SBOM, SAST, DAST, Secret Scanning) within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Apply manual network/application testing, custom scripting, and unit test cases to validate controls.
  • Recommend improvements to existing security tools, processes, and secure coding standards.

Vulnerability Management

  • Drive vulnerability management with a focus on Kubernetes (K8s) and container images.
  • Triage, validate (including writing PoCs), and prioritize scanning tool findings.
  • Communicate security issues to stakeholders and manage remediation throughout the SDLC

Incident Response and Compliance

  • Support product security incident response, including root cause analysis, mitigation strategies, and creation of technical runbooks.
  • Apply Detection Engineering principles, setting baseline app security parameters and maintaining IDS/IPS rules.
  • Conduct post-incident analysis and lessons learned to refine response strategies.
  • Monitor emerging threats to proactively integrate new protections and ensure compliance with standards (OWASP, NIST).


Basic Requirements

Basic Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience & Education: 7+ years in Security/Application Engineering; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

description:
Company:

Ascension at Home together with Compassus


Position Summary: The Clinical Care Partner III is responsible for coordinating safe, efficient, and patient-centered transitions of care for hospitalized patients. This role evaluates patients for appropriate post-acute home-based care services and supports timely, high-quality discharge planning in collaboration with physicians, case management, patients, families, and post-acute providers.

The position focuses on improving patient outcomes, reducing length of stay and readmissions, and ensuring patients receive the right care in the right setting at the right time. This is an in-person role requiring bedside engagement, interdisciplinary collaboration, and active participation in discharge planning workflows.


Position Specific Responsibilities:

Referral Evaluation & Clinical Assessment

  • Evaluate patients for appropriateness for home-based and post-acute care services based on clinical, functional, psychosocial, and environmental factors
  • Review inpatient referrals and prioritize patients using clinical judgment and predictive analytics tools
  • Collaborate with physicians and care teams to support appropriate level-of-care decisions
  • Identify patients appropriate for value-based post-acute care services

Discharge Coordination & Care Transitions

  • Coordinate and facilitate timely, safe, and appropriate hospital discharge planning
  • Develop and implement individualized transition-of-care plans aligned with patient needs and clinical goals
  • Partner with physicians, advanced practice providers, case management, and nursing teams
  • Arrange post-acute services including home health, hospice, durable medical equipment, medications, and follow-up care
  • Ensure accurate and timely patient handoff to post-acute providers

Stakeholder Education

  • Educate patients and families on post-acute care options, care expectations, and available services
  • Provide bedside education to support informed patient choice and shared decision-making
  • Educate hospital staff and clinical stakeholders on post-acute pathways and referral processes

title: International Trade Marketeer
description:
• Shape how Quooker’s premium brand comes to life across international retail and partner channels.

  • Turn commercial opportunities and insights from local markets into scalable trade marketing concepts, frameworks and tools that can be activated across countries.

  • Connect colleagues across countries and functions, share best practices and enable local teams to activate Quooker more successfully in their markets.

As International Trade Marketeer, you play a key role in strengthening Quooker’s position across our international dealer network. You develop scalable trade marketing concepts, retail solutions and frameworks that enable local teams to activate Quooker effectively within their own markets.

Working closely with Country Managers, local Marketing teams, Sales, Consumer Marketing and Digital, you identify cross-market opportunities to improve Quooker’s visibility and impact at the point of sale. You translate Quooker’s premium positioning into scalable retail concepts, guidelines and commercial tools that help local teams create compelling retail experiences and enable our partners to sell Quooker more effectively.

You take ownership of developing international trade marketing concepts for product displays, showroom presentations, sales materials, retail activations and dealer marketing. Together with Quooker’s internal Design Studio and external partners, you translate these concepts into scalable toolkits and guidelines that local teams can adapt to their markets. You coordinate international projects from concept to delivery and ensure that solutions are delivered on time, within budget and to a consistently high standard.

You also contribute to the continuous improvement of Quooker’s international dealer marketing ecosystem. You help develop the dealer portal and ensure local teams and partners have easy access to scalable marketing materials, product information, training resources and sales support tools.

In this role, you work closely with colleagues across Quooker’s international markets. You identify recurring needs and opportunities across countries and turn these into solutions that benefit the wider Quooker organisation. By connecting local market insights, best practices and learnings, you determine where local opportunities can be translated into scalable international approaches. In doing so, you strengthen global consistency while giving local teams the flexibility to activate Quooker effectively within their own markets.

About your team

You will be part of Quooker’s international Marketing team and report directly to the Head of Trade Marketing. You will work closely with fellow Trade Marketeers and specialists across the wider Marketing team, and collaborate with colleagues across 19 markets to strengthen and scale Quooker’s international trade marketing approach.

  • At least 5 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Retail Marketing, Channel Marketing or a comparable role.

  • Experience working across multiple markets and translating different local needs into international solutions.

  • Proven experience developing retail concepts, frameworks, toolkits or activation programmes that can be implemented across different markets.

  • A strong understanding of dealer networks, retail environments and customer decision-making.

  • The ability to translate commercial and brand ambitions into scalable trade marketing solutions.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence colleagues across countries and functions without direct authority.

  • Strong project management skills and experience coordinating international, cross-functional projects.

  • The ability to distinguish between local market needs and opportunities that can be addressed through a scalable international solution.

  • A proactive and collaborative way of working, with the ability to move from insight and concept to implementation.

  • The ability to manage multiple international projects, markets and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

title: Merchandise Handler I

We inspire purpose-filled living that brings joy to the modern home. With a team of more than 8,000 associates spanning 130 store and distribution locations across the U.S. and Canada, we achieve together, drive results and innovate to inspire. Drawn together by a shared passion for our customers and a spirit of fun, we deliver high-quality home furnishings that are expertly designed, responsibly sourced and bring beauty and function to people’s homes. From the day we opened our first store in Chicago in 1962 to the digital innovations that engage millions of customers today, our iconic brand is nearly 60 years in the making—and our story is still unfolding.

The Merchandise Handler I executes various core distribution center activities to support the processing, movement, and fulfillment of products and customer orders. This role handles inbound/outbound shipments, order picking, packing, inventory movement, and storage while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and efficiency.

A day in the life as a Merchandise Handler I...

  • Daily Productivity & Operations: Perform all assigned tasks to achieve and maintain daily productivity and quality goals.

  • Flexibility & Rotation: Rotate through different departments as necessary to meet business demands.

  • Continuous Improvement: Participate in ongoing training regarding technology upgrades, new systems, and operational procedures.

  • Housekeeping: Maintain a clean and safe work area by disposing of boxes, packing materials, and pallets, ensuring general facility cleanliness.

  • Communication: Report issues, inventory errors, damage, or location system problems promptly to leadership.

Departmental Duties

Loading / Unloading:

  • Load and unload trailers manually or using dollies.

  • Build stable pallets and stage unloaded merchandise accurately.

​

Packing:

  • Assemble boxes, package merchandise, fill, label, and perform final quality checks on orders to ensure correct packaging standards.

  • Execute brand-specific "gift packaging" services as required.

​

Picking:

  • Accurately pick customer orders using automated technologies (voice picking, robotic tools, conveyor systems).

  • Spend extended periods walking and moving across large facility areas to locate products.

Shipping & Receiving:

  • Verify received and outbound merchandise against manifests/tickets; tally shipments and record overages, shortages, or damages.

  • Confirm inventory using RF scanners, print put away/picking/shipping labels and liaise with the shipping/receiving office.

​

Stocking & Replenishment:

  • Sort, unwrap, unpack, identify, label, and palletize products.

  • Replenish merchandise into designated pick locations using handheld RF equipment.

What you'll bring to the table...

  • Communication & Collaboration: Effective communication skills with the ability to work productively in a team environment.

  • Detail-Oriented: High level of accuracy and attention to detail when handling, picking, packing, or verifying inventory.

  • Safety & Compliance: Maintain strong awareness of loss prevention, security, and safety standards per Company Code of Conduct and policy manuals.

  • System Aptitude: Understanding of operational resources, technology, and training materials.

  • Language Proficiency: Basic English language proficiency.

Physical and Visual Activities...

  • Visual Acuity: Constant near and far vision required.

  • Movement: Daily standing, walking, bending, reaching, kneeling, crouching, twisting, pushing/pulling, and remaining stationary/standing for long periods.

  • Lifting Capacity: Ability to regularly move/lift up to 65 lbs. to a height of 3–4 feet (heavier items moved with team assistance). Ability to move furniture/large items up to 300 lbs. using appropriate equipment.

  • Equipment & Technology Use: Ability to operate computers, RF scanners, POS/office tools.

Work Environment

  • Exposure to varying temperatures (hot/cold changes), concrete floors, dust, odors, and potential mechanical, electrical, or chemical hazards standard to a distribution setting.

The programme

A UK bank is undertaking a major payments transformation, simplifying a complex and fragmented estate toward a modern, harmonised target state. This role helps drive the vendor selection and pins down what the bank actually needs.

The role

You will work alongside the Payments Architect and the bank's team to determine the right architectural option for the target payments estate and land on the right vendor solution. Where the Architect owns the design, you own running the selection and defining the requirements that sit under it.

  • Strong requirements definition, able to translate a complex multi-platform estate into clear, high-level requirements

Alongside this role

This sits on a wider payments programme with a Payments Architect owning the technical design. If your strength is owning the architecture and integration patterns rather than running the selection, flag that and we can point you to the right seat.

Six months initial, hybrid with time on-site in London. Outside IR35 (status pending final confirmation). Day rate on application.

title: Life Enrichment Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

The Life Enrichment Specialist (LES), reporting directly to the Director of Education & Engagement, provides leadership, training, and operational oversight for life enrichment and memory care programming across multiple Cedarhurst communities, traveling as needed to support locations requiring assistance. This position works within Cedarhurst communities to support Life Enrichment teams, ensure consistent delivery of high-quality and engaging programming, and promote resident well-being and family engagement. The LES oversees community initiatives such as the implementation and monitoring of electronic life enrichment platforms, family engagement programs, and Cedarhurst’s memory care model. The Life Enrichment Specialist also plays a key role in mentoring Life Enrichment leaders, fostering positive resident and family experiences, supporting new community openings and acquisitions, and promoting Cedarhurst’s core values through meaningful engagement and person-centered approaches.


This role requires frequent weekly travel across assigned communities and includes an auto and phone allowance.


Why Work for Cedarhurst:

  • At Cedarhurst, our core values guide how we work together and how we care for those we serve. We expect every team member to be passionate, trustworthy, empathetic, positive, respectful, and approachable. Being part of Cedarhurst means making a meaningful difference every day.
  • We believe our team is our greatest strength. That’s why we invest in comprehensive training, as well as opportunities for both personal and professional growth. We’re committed to promoting from within and supporting team members who want to build their careers with us.
  • Cedarhurst offers a competitive benefits package, including medical insurance, life insurance, long-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan with company match (after one year of service) for eligible employees.
  • Work that makes a difference in the lives of our residents and community
  • Access to our St. Louis Home Office, which includes an on-site gym with brand new equipment, personal training, group classes, and stretching sessions (for visiting or office-based team members)
  • Catered lunches and regular team events at our Home Office
  • Auto and phone allowance to support you in a mobile, travel-based role
  • Meaningful opportunities to build relationships with residents, families, and team members across multiple communities

Essential Duties:

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • Support Community Leadership and Life Enrichment teams in optimizing each resident’s well-being.
  • Apply critical thinking to develop and implement approaches that enhance resident engagement.
  • Support existing Cedarhurst communities and assist during acquisitions and new community openings.
  • Oversee community implementation and monitoring of electronic life enrichment platforms, family engagement programs, memory care programming, and other life enrichment initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other regional support leaders to enhance residents’ lives through engagement and programming.
  • Coordinate education, training, and mentoring opportunities for Life Enrichment team members.
  • Implement and monitor adoption of the Company’s memory care model.
  • Oversee development and maintenance of life enrichment, activities, and memory care programming in compliance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.
  • Provide ongoing learning and skill development related to life enrichment and memory care best practices.
  • Fill in as full time Life Enrichment Director or Coordinator in communities as needed.
  • Conduct on site visits to ensure Life Enrichment and Memory Care standards are met.
  • Provide guidance on resident rights concerns and grievances with residents, families, and employees.
  • Develop resources and remain current with emerging best practices in life enrichment and memory care.
  • Flexibility to assist additional regions life enrichment programs as needed.
  • Assist with hiring and on-boarding of new Life Enrichment Directors and Coordinators.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Education and/or Experience:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.

  • Two (2) or more years of experience in a senior care community, with demonstrated leadership and organizational skills, preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Recreation Therapy, Social Work, Gerontology, Nursing, Health Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • State-required license or certification as a Life Enrichment/Activity Professional preferred.
  • Self-motivated and accountable with a proactive approach to completing tasks and achieving results.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Working Conditions:

  • As part of The Dover Company’s commitment to providing outstanding care and support, the company ensures that staff work under conditions that prioritize safety, collaboration, and professional growth. The conditions listed below define the experience of working in the Home Office or remotely.
  • This position may involve a range of physical activities, including those outlined in the Essential Duties, but is not limited to them. This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods of time.
  • This position may need to lift or move up to fifty (50) pounds independently and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • This position may need to move through areas of the communities or other worksites of the organization, including the Home Office.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager

Location: United Kingdom Offsite (ZUK99)

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Offer Management team is responsible for the design, development, launch and maintenance of integrated Services and Products within the Motorola Solutions Portfolio. This includes bringing together all the industry leading products, services and software capabilities of Motorola Solutions to create the Offer Solution. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for collaborating closely with the Offer Management team to drive cross-functional strategic offer execution, mentoring junior PM talent, building data dashboards using advanced metrics and AI tooling, and navigating key stakeholder relationships to deliver critical business results.


Job Description

This role is primarily remote working with very occasional travel to our London offices.

The ideal candidate is an experienced professional who bridges the gap between high-level business strategy and tactical execution, has a strong grasp of macro business outcomes, and has a natural ability to coach and mentor junior talent. You are a data-first professional who leverages modern tooling—including advanced data analytics and AI execution—to build robust reporting frameworks and dashboards. You are highly comfortable interacting with senior leaders and thrive in an environment that rewards critical thinking, adaptability, and continuous learning.

Strategic Execution & Leadership

  • Manage complex, cross-functional initiatives from inception to delivery, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and ROI.
  • Champion PMO methodologies, continuously refining processes, governance, and templates to increase organizational velocity and maturity.
  • Anticipate project risks and bottlenecks, proactively developing mitigation strategies before they impact business operations.

Team Mentorship & Coaching

  • Act as a core mentor to junior PMs, accelerating their professional development and upgrading the team’s collective execution capabilities.
  • Conduct process and framework reviews for the broader team, ensuring high standards of project management hygiene across all workstreams.

Advanced Data, Metrics & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and operational metrics that provide leadership with clear, actionable insights.
  • Utilize advanced data manipulation techniques within Google Sheets, writing complex formulas and leveraging AI tools (e.g., LLMs, advanced data analysis prompts) to optimize data structures and automate reporting workflows.
  • Translate dense project data into high-level strategic narratives for executive consumption.

Executive Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted partner to senior leadership, confidently presenting project statuses, risk profiles, and strategic recommendations.
  • Navigate ambiguous, high-stakes situations with emotional intelligence, discretion, and a constant focus on business impact.

Project Management

  • Demonstrate best practices for developing and managing schedules and understand risks, interdependencies and the critical path.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders (internal and external) to obtain buy-in, resolve conflicts and drive successful delivery of projects.
  • Manages expectations of project stakeholders with timely communication/escalation of risks/issues, their impact, and mitigation/corrective actions.


Basic Requirements

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

  • 7+ years of progressive project/program management experience, preferably with experience in Service - Implementation, Telecommunications, Radio Communications, or Aerospace/Defence preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or similar is preferred.
  • Demonstrated competency with a project management tool (e.g. MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet).
  • Deep understanding of how project deliverables impact the broader business operations, P&L, and strategic objectives.
  • Advanced expertise in Google Sheets (complex formulas, nested functions, data modelling) combined with a demonstrated ability to use AI tools to augment and accelerate technical workflows.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to command a room, influence stakeholders, and mentor junior peers.
  • An insatiable appetite for learning new technologies, methodologies, and business domains.
  • Highly organized, structured, and process oriented; team building skills a plus.
  • Certified PMP preferred and Agile/Scrum Certification an advantage.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 7+ years of experience.

Cedarhurst Senior Living is a leading provider of senior living communities, dedicated to enriching the lives of residents through exceptional care and personalized services. Why Work for Cedarhurst:

Along with comprehensive benefits, we offer GROW Points—a unique rewards system that celebrates your hard work and dedication. You’ll also enjoy perks like exclusive Skechers shoe discounts, early paycheck access, and more!

Position Summary:

The Dining Server is responsible for delivering an exceptional dining experience for residents and guests by providing courteous and efficient table service, maintaining high standards of cleanliness and food safety, and ensuring dining areas are welcoming and sanitary. This role supports daily meal service as well as special events, assists with food preparation and cost control, and collaborates with team members to uphold Cedarhurst’s dining standards. The Dining Server also communicates effectively with residents and families, responds to individual dining needs, and contributes to a safe and positive environment that reflects the company’s commitment to quality service and resident wellbeing.


Essential Functions:

  • Assist with catering, room service, special events, and marketing functions, ensuring smooth execution and resident satisfaction.
  • Promptly take food and beverage orders and deliver service to residents and guests in a courteous, accurate, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain a clean and sanitary work area by washing pots, pans, and utensils used in meal preparation, following all food safety standards.

  • Prepare and maintain table settings to meet Cedarhurst’s established dining standards and create a welcoming atmosphere.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations (FDA, state, county, local) and ensure full adherence to all food handling and sanitation guidelines.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. The sheer scale of our capabilities and client engagements and the way we collaborate, operate and deliver value provides an unparalleled opportunity to grow and advance. Choose Accenture and make delivering innovative work part of your extraordinary career.

About The Role

We are seeking an Endpoint Security Process Consultant to design, document, and operationalise the business and technical processes required to run endpoint security, DLP, and vulnerability management capabilities effectively.

This role bridges security delivery, operations, governance, and service management, ensuring that endpoint security controls are supported by clear processes, accountabilities, workflow integration, reporting, and handover artefacts.

What you'll be responsible for


Define and document endpoint security operating processes across endpoint protection, DLP, and vulnerability management capabilities.
Develop process flows, RACI models, runbooks, work instructions, exception processes, and operational handover material.
Design workflows for vulnerability identification, prioritisation, remediation assignment, tracking, escalation, and closure.
Support DLP operating model design, including alert triage, incident referral, policy exception handling, evidence capture, and reporting.
Work with technical engineers to translate Trellix and Tenable platform capabilities into repeatable operational processes.
Support integration of endpoint security processes with ITSM, change management, incident management, problem management, and reporting forums.
Facilitate workshops with security, infrastructure, operations, governance, and application teams to agree process ownership and handoffs.
Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
Support readiness assessments, transition-to-operations planning, and hyper care activities.
Maintain process documentation and support training or knowledge transfer for operational teams.


What we're looking for


Approximately 5 years’ experience in security operations, cyber process design, IT service management, vulnerability management, endpoint security, or technology delivery roles.
Strong understanding of endpoint security operations, DLP workflows, and vulnerability management lifecycle processes.
Experience documenting operational processes, runbooks, RACIs, workflow diagrams, service models, or transition artefacts.
Familiarity with Trellix, Tenable, ITSM tooling, and enterprise security operations practices desirable.
Ability to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders to define practical, supportable processes.
Strong communication, facilitation, structured analysis, and documentation skills.
Experience in regulated or security-sensitive delivery environments desirable.


Security Clearance


Current Australian Government security clearance (Baseline, NV1 or higher), or
Eligibility and willingness to undergo security clearance.


Must be willing to work onsite 5 days a week

title: Facility Engineer (Mandarin Speaker) - Data Center

Facility Engineer (Mandarin Speaker) - Data Center

Critical Facility Operations & Monitoring

Operate and monitor mission-critical data center infrastructure to ensure maximum availability and compliance with uptime requirements.

Conduct routine facility rounds, inspections, and operational checks to identify abnormalities and potential risks.

Monitor key operational parameters such as temperature, humidity, power consumption, voltage, current, pressure, and equipment performance.

Electrical Systems Operation & Maintenance

Operate and maintain critical electrical infrastructure including: Medium Voltage (MV) & Low Voltage (LV) systems, Transformers, Switchgear, UPS systems and battery bank, Static Transfer Switch (STS), Power Distribution Units (PDU/RPP), Diesel generators and fuel systems, Grounding and lightning protection systems.

Support preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and emergency recovery activities.

Mechanical & Cooling Systems Operation

Monitor cooling performance to maintain optimal environmental conditions for IT equipment.

Perform initial troubleshooting of mechanical failures and coordinate escalation with vendors or specialized teams.

Execute and supervise preventive maintenance activities according to maintenance schedules and OEM recommendations.

Review maintenance procedures, Method of Procedure (MOP), and risk assessments before maintenance execution.

Manage contractor/vendor activities, ensuring compliance with safety procedures, quality standards, and service level agreements (SLA).

Witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and commissioning activities for new equipment.

Act as the first responder for critical facility alarms and incidents.

Perform initial troubleshooting, impact assessment, temporary mitigation, and escalation according to escalation matrices.

Participate in emergency operations such as power failures, UPS failures, generator failures, cooling failures, water leakage, and fire alarms.

Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

Prepare and maintain: Shift logs, Maintenance reports, Incident reports, Equipment history records, SOP, MOP, and EOP documents.

Participate in internal/external audits and support compliance requirements.

title: Supervisor, Recoveries
description:
Job Description

Supervisor, Recoveries

Human Services - Social Development, Planning and Partnerships

Status: Regular Full Time

Salary Range: Non Union, Salary Band I

Hiring Range: $105,754 per annum to $118,974 per annum (plus comprehensive benefits)

Work Mode: Hybrid; 2 Onsite days per week which can increase based on operational needs *see below for more details about this work mode.

Location: 10 Peel Centre Drive, Brampton ON

Hours of work: 35 Hours per week

Who we are:

The Program Funding Support team provides funding related support for the Early Years and Child Care, Housing and Ontario Works programs. These supports include the recovery of subsidy overpayment's for former clients, payment management and processing, eligibility reviews and fraud investigations, and appeals adjudication/tribunal representation.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

The Recovery Unit focus within Program Funding Support is to ensure that all revenues owed to Human Services are diligently pursued and that all revenue received is recorded and reported accurately. Accurate reporting ensures that the Form 5 information (used to bill the province) is correct. Revenue recovered helps to off-set the cost of program service delivery.

The focus of the Recovery Team is to support the Ontario Works (OW) program, Early Years and Child Care (EYCC) program and Peel Housing Corporation (PHC) in the Region of Peel. This team ensures that all revenues owed by former clients and tenants are correctly identified, diligently pursued, collected, deposited, tracked and reported. The income recovered and reported by the Recovery Team help to offset the cost of social assistance to the Region.

Reporting to: Manager, Program Funding Support

Team Structure: In this role you will Supervise a team of unionized employees consisting of 7 Financial Recovery Coordinators (FRCs).

What you will do in this role:

  • Supervise employees through a variety of activities including hiring, coaching, motivating, developing job objectives, disciplining, managing performance, assigning and delegating work and ensuring quality and service standards are met.
  • Supervise the Financial Recovery Coordinators who ensure Human Services collection practices adhere to legislative requirements through policy and established practices.
  • Supervise the activities related to the collection, analysis and evaluation of data in order to maximize revenues for the Human Services Department.
  • Supervise a complex portfolio with the ability to balance competing interests and priorities of clients from different program areas within Human Services. Ensure that work activity aligns with departmental priorities in relation to the Human Services Plan and the overall departmental direction.
  • Authorize weekly deposits as well as addresses overpayment internal appeals.
  • Accountable for maintaining security profiles and assigning appropriate profiles to authorized staff in relevant financial systems the recovery staff database; and ensures the integrity of both systems.
  • Resolve escalated client issues that staff are not able to deal with.
  • Respond to elected official inquiries.
  • Authorize bankruptcy-related documents on behalf of the Region of Peel.
  • Refer terminated client files to a private collection agency to retrieve amounts owing to the Region of Peel; responsible for managing the inventory of client information; liaise with the Collection agency on client issues.
  • Authorize staff to consult with Corporate Legal Representatives when contentious issues arise regarding legal assignments and direction on policy and legislation.
  • Effectively controls and manages the collection of revenue exceeding $3-4 million annually.
  • Respond to financial related questions posed by the Internal and External Auditors.
  • Assist the Manager by projecting and/or identifying trends and risks through statistical analysis. Provide regular reporting on monthly collection activities across relevant Human Services program areas.
  • Provide input to the Manager on the operational budget for the Recoveries Unit.
  • Maintain a thorough knowledge of related programs and computer systems pertaining to human services.
  • Support the service delivery requirements and complies with regulation requirements as identified but not limited to the following Acts: Ontario Works, Housing Services Act, Child Care and Early Years Act (CCEYA), Ontario Disability Support Program, Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy, Child and Family Services, Residential Tenancy and Bankruptcy Law.
  • Liaise with third parties such as Service Canada, Trustees, Lawyers, Insurance Companies, Ontario Disability Support Program, the Family Responsibility Office, other Municipalities, Elected Officials and Regional Council.
  • Understand provincial programs and policies as well as departmental policies, objectives and strategic plans in the context of corporate wide objectives.
  • Develop and implements processes in line with the Corporate Process Management and Improvement Methodology.
  • Promote a client-centered and service-oriented culture which supports teamwork and integration and models the Regional values.
  • Develop relationships with all divisions in the department; participates in cross functional initiatives

What the role requires:

  • Post secondary education in Human Services or related field, finance or public administration or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five (5) years of related work experience
  • Demonstrated formal leadership experience and skills (minimum 2 years preferred) and an understanding of leading within a unionized environment.
  • Working knowledge of legislation that directs and supports the delivery of Human Services programs and services such as the Ontario Works Act, the Ontario Disability Support Program Act, the Bankruptcy Act, the Housing Services Act, the Child Care and Early Years Act (CCEYA), the Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act, the Child and Family Services Act and the Residential Tenancy Act.
  • Working knowledge of systems used to support the delivery of Human Services programs and services such as SAMs, OCCMS, CSPay, CMS, , HTI, PowerBI and Microsoft Office.
  • Knowledge of social assistance programs, social services, municipal government, provincial government, and community resources and services
  • Knowledge of acts, programs and policies relating to WSIB, OSAP, Service Canada (CPP, OAS and EI), immigration and sponsorship, bankruptcy, Family Responsibility Office, collections and portability process requirements.

Skills/Abilities:

  • Effective time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proven organizational skills with an emphasis on being detailed-oriented.
  • Political awareness, sufficient to identify and respond to situations using tact and diplomacy to understand the various parties and stakeholders involved in decision making processes, and to anticipate their likely reaction to statements, proposals, recommendations and situations.
  • Possess strong research, analytical, problem solving and quantitative skills, necessary to gather and analyze data.
  • A demonstrated commitment to high-quality work, and the ability to proactively identify issues, evaluate options, and implement practical solutions.
  • Interpersonal skills to liaise internal and external stakeholders in a sensitive and effective manner.
  • Sound judgment and critical thinking skills.
  • Experience in applying change management principles and methodologies with an in-depth understanding of change management and the ability to lead, manage and support change.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Working knowledge of Corporate Process Management and Improvement Methodology.
  • Short and long term planning skills and ability to execute plans as it relates to revenue collection, risk management and budgetary management.
  • The ability to present to various audiences both internal and external to Peel
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias

Perks @ Peel and why you will love working for us:

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, Vision benefit plan including psychological health, effective start date
  • Automatic enrolment into OMERS pension plan
  • Accrue Vacation on a monthly basis starting at 3 weeks per annum
  • 3 Paid personal days and floating holidays
  • Flexible hours supporting your wellness and wellbeing
  • Annual performance review and merit increases based on performance
  • Supportive leadership and a culture of respect and inclusion
  • Access to tuition reimbursement and learning and development resources

Be bold. Think big. Join us.

In this role, you’ll benefit from the flexibility of a hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes meaningful in-person connection. A minimum of two days per week on-site is expected, with additional in-person presence as operational needs evolve. This arrangement allows for a blend of in person and hybrid work that adapts to support both organizational priorities and employee flexibility and is subject to change over time.

A strong focus is placed on data governance, including implementing quality checks, monitoring and observability frameworks, ensuring compliance with security and privacy standards, and managing metadata and lineage using tools like Unity Catalog. description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

This is a remote role well suited to an ambitious professional, looking for the next step in their career.

As a Sr.Software Project Manager, Complex Projects you will be responsible

for:

Must live within Southwest Zone: AR, AZ, CO, KS, ND, NE, NM, OK, SD, TX, UT, WY

  • Experience with SAP or equivalent ERP products and productivity software desired.

  • Availability to support projects within Central and Mountain US time zones.

  • Knowledge of the use and deployment of software in a healthcare environment, especially as applied to cancer care settings

  • Project Management experience / certifications

Candidates with strong experience across the following areas are particularly encouraged to apply:

  • Strong Python development and scripting experience – ESSENTIAL

  • Hands-on DevOps experience, particularly using Python – ESSENTIAL

  • Apache NiFi experience within containerised environments – HIGHLY DESIRABLE

  • Strong CI/CD pipeline management, maintenance and troubleshooting experience – ESSENTIAL

  • Strong hands-on Amazon Web Services (AWS) experience – ESSENTIAL

  • Experience with Linux/UNIX environments

  • Experience with containerisation technologies and cloud-based deployments

  • Experience using Git-based version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket

  • Strong understanding of secure software engineering and development practices

  • Experience working within secure Australian Government ICT environments

Desirable Experience

  • Background in Cyber Security or related domains

  • Experience with automation, deployment and orchestration tools

  • Experience with SQL / PL/SQL and data technologies

  • Exposure to Hadoop / Apache Spark

  • Linux and/or Windows system administration experience

  • Experience working within IRAP / ISM-aligned environments

Work Arrangement

  • Location: Canberra, ACT

  • Contract: 12 months

  • Start: Immediate / ASAP

  • Work Type: Predominantly onsite in a secure ASD environment

  • Hours: Up to 40 hours per week

  • Rates: SUPER EXCELLENT / HIGHLY COMPETITIVE CONTRACT RATES

Eligibility & Security Requirements

  • Must be an Australian Citizen

  • Must hold a current NV1 Security Clearance or higher

  • Willingness to undergo an Organisational Suitability Assessment (OSA) if required

  • Must be available to work in Canberra, ACT

How to Apply

If you are an NV1-cleared Software Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Python + DevOps + AWS + CI/CD, and ideally Apache NiFi in containerised environments, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Please submit:

  • Your updated resume

  • A one-page pitch addressing the relevant criteria

  • Your availability / earliest start date

  • Your hourly rate

  • Your current security clearance level

Immediate availability is highly regarded. SUPER EXCELLENT RATES are available for suitably experienced candidates.

Job Duties

  • Under general direction, serves as Project Manager for assigned Real Estate Services projects, including the design, construction, renovation, expansion, consolidation, relocation, or replacement of company offices, laboratories, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, service centers, and site infrastructure assets.
  • Leads projects through all phases of the project lifecycle, including planning, budgeting, execution, occupancy, and closeout.

Job Description:

AI Architect – Modern AI Applications

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As a AI Architect with deep expertise in Machine learning, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Natural Language Understanding (NLU), you will lead high-impact AI Platform development for HIS applications. In this role, you will be a hands-on research and development leader - driving technical breakthroughs, designing novel AI architectures, and directly influencing the integration of advanced AI into mission-critical healthcare products. You will collaborate closely with other scientists, engineers, and domain experts to create platform/solutions that are explainable, reliable, and transformative for healthcare operations.

This role is focused on building scalable AI platforms and frameworks from scratch and is not a data science or model experimentation role.

Key Responsibilities
Healthcare-Focused AI Development

  • Architect, design and develop AI platform to support large language models to handle healthcare-specific language, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations.

  • Frameworks which can support AI pipelines that can process structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes, claims data).

  • Contribute to domain-specific model architectures that improve clinical decision-making, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary technical authority on any AI Platform related development within product teams.

  • Mentor junior AI designers and engineers through code reviews, research guidance, and technical workshops.

  • Drive internal knowledge-sharing on emerging AI trends, frameworks, and best practices.

Operational & Compliance Excellence

  • Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.

  • Ensure compliance with healthcare privacy and data security regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST).

  • Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments.

Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field AND 10+ years of experience in developing AI/ML platform on Cloud & on-Prem.

Or

  • 15+ software engineering background in AI, Machine Learning, or related field with 10+ years of experience in building AI/ML platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python, and modern ML libraries.

  • Experience with GenAI, LLMs, transformer architectures, and advanced Model Routing (dynamically selecting and orchestrating open-source vs. proprietary models based on latency, cost, and capability tiers).

  • Skilled with AI development tools and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).

  • Deep expertise in building enterprise-grade RAG systems, including advanced chunking, hybrid search, vector database management, and retrieval optimization.

  • Hands-on experience with autonomous AI agents and reasoning systems, specifically mastering Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocols and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent orchestration.

  • Advanced skills in AgentContext Management, including context window optimization, stateful memory injection, caching strategies, and managing long-running agent contexts.

  • Proven ability in Observability, Logging, and Scalable systems, including specialized LLM/Agent tracing to monitor reasoning steps, token usage, and system latency.

  • Strong track record applying AI architectures to scalable, generic enterprise platforms and complex use cases.

  • Strong background with cloud platforms, On-Prem deployments, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role;

  • Experience with Knowledge Graph DBs (e.g., Neo4j), NoSQL/SQL databases, and native Vector databases, particularly in designing advanced GraphRAG and hybrid-retrieval architectures.

  • Strong background in containerization and infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).

  • Familiarity with advanced multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) for complex, stateful workflow execution.

  • Proven ability to take complex AI Architecture/Design—especially non-deterministic LLM and multi-agent systems—from concept to highly available, production-grade deployments.

  • Experience with LLM Evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, LLM-as-a-Judge) to continuously monitor and score agent reasoning and RAG retrieval quality.

  • Knowledge of model fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT) and model distillation to create smaller, task-specific models that optimize cost and latency within the model routing layer.

  • Familiarity with implementing platform-wide AI guardrails, prompt injection defenses, and output validation mechanisms.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side‑by‑side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life‑changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client‑first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life‑changing impact to ZS.

Overview:

We’re hiring a senior engineer who can own problems end‑to‑end. Someone who’s spent 10–15+ years building production software and has figured out how to use AI tooling to do it dramatically faster—not by cutting corners, but by having the judgment to know which corners don’t need to exist.

This isn’t a “full stack developer who uses Copilot” role. We’re looking for someone who can take an ambiguous client problem, figure out what needs to be built, build it, ship it, and iterate—often in days instead of weeks. You’ll work across data platforms, APIs, web applications, and increasingly, agentic systems that act autonomously on behalf of users.

You’ll be one of the first hires in a pilot model we’re testing: small teams, senior people, high autonomy, fast delivery. If this works, it changes how we build software across the firm. That’s the bet.

What You’ll Do:

Own Delivery End-to-End

  • Take client problems from scoping through architecture, build, deployment, and iteration. You’re not waiting for a spec.
  • Deliver production‑grade applications across the stack: React/TypeScript frontends, Node.js or .NET APIs, Azure cloud services, data pipelines on Databricks.
  • Use AI‑assisted workflows (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, whatever works) to compress timelines. The expectation isn’t that you use specific tools—it’s that you ship fast without sacrificing quality.

Design & Build Agentic Systems

  • Architect and build autonomous agent systems that can reason, plan, use tools, and take actions in real‑world workflows—not just chatbot wrappers.
  • Design agent orchestration patterns: multi‑agent coordination, human‑in‑the‑loop checkpoints, tool use, memory, and context management.
  • Build the infrastructure that supports agentic deployment: evaluation frameworks, guardrails, monitoring, and observability for systems that act on their own.
  • Stay close to the frontier. The tooling is moving fast (LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, custom orchestration). You should have opinions about what works and what doesn’t.

Multiply the Team

  • Build reusable accelerators—deployment pipelines, security patterns, API scaffolding, agent frameworks that compound across engagements.
  • Raise the engineering bar on projects you touch. Code review, architecture guidance, and pattern‑setting, not just your own output.
  • Help less experienced engineers get better at using AI tooling effectively. Not through training decks—through working alongside them.

Prototype and Prove Things Out

  • Turn business ideas into working prototypes quickly enough that stakeholders can react to real software, not slides.
  • Build proof‑of‑conceptions, internal tools, dashboards, and client‑facing portals. Some will ship; some will inform decisions. Both matter.
  • Generate architecture options, technical documentation, and solution accelerators using AI—then apply judgment about which option is actually right.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 10–15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent building and shipping production systems.
  • Strong full‑stack fundamentals: React/TypeScript, Node.js or .NET, REST APIs, microservices, relational and document databases.
  • Working experience with Azure cloud services (or equivalent depth in AWS/GCP with willingness to context‑switch).
  • Proven, practical use of AI development tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) in actual delivery—not just experimentation.
  • Experience designing or building agentic AI systems: autonomous agents, multi‑agent orchestration, tool‑use architectures, or agent evaluation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts and platforms (Databricks, Spark, or similar) sufficient to build data‑aware applications.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making architectural decisions without a committee.
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Semantic Kernel, or custom implementations).
  • Experience with MuleSoft or enterprise integration platforms.
  • Hands‑on work with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and fine‑tuning workflows.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure‑as‑code.
  • Experience building internal developer tools or productivity accelerators.
  • Background in consulting or client‑facing delivery environments
  • Fluency in English
  • Client‑first mentality
  • Intense work ethic
  • Collaborative spirit and problem‑solving approach

How you’ll grow:

  • Cross‑functional skills development & custom learning pathways
  • Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
  • Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s‑curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in Canada, visit ZS Canada office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on‑site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face‑to‑face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client‑facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
