title: Personal Fitness Trainer
description:
Personal Fitness Trainer – Snap Fitness Woodlands


Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Club Manager / CEO

Location: Woodlands, Singapore

Read This Before You Apply

At Snap Fitness Singapore exceptional performance gets rewarded directly, in money, not in compliments. Our commission system means two trainers doing the same job can take home very different pay — and the one earning $8,000 a month didn’t get lucky. They coached well, they sold well, and they kept doing both, month after month. Your base salary itself grows with your track record, so consistency compounds.

The flip side: if you’re allergic to sales, or you believe a trainer’s job ends when the session ends, this role will frustrate you. We want people who are hungry — who see every gym orientation as the start of a relationship and every member on the floor as someone they could genuinely help. If that’s you, we will invest in you: certifications, education etc. and a real career path. We back our people harder than any gym you’ve worked at. We just expect you to give us a reason to.

About the Role

Snap Fitness Singapore is growing, and we’re hiring a full-time Personal Trainer for our Woodlands club. You’ll deliver personal training and group classes, own the member experience from first orientation onwards, and build your own book of clients — with our systems, our brand, and our investment behind you.

We’re open to experienced trainers and to newer trainers with real potential. What we care about is coachability, drive, and whether you treat this as a career. If you do, we’re prepared to fund your development — courses, certifications, and mentorship included.

What You’ll Own

  • Your client book — building and retaining a base of personal training clients through orientations, follow-ups, and results that speak for themselves
  • Coaching quality — structured, progressive programs tailored to each client’s goals: strength, fat loss, muscle building, or general health. Safe, effective, and demonstrated hands-on
  • Group classes — designing and leading sessions that bring energy to the floor and turn class members into a community (and into PT clients)
  • Member onboarding — gym orientations for new members: equipment, safety, basic programming, and making people feel they belong here from day one
  • Progress and accountability — tracking client results with body scanners and the Snap App, running regular assessments, and adjusting programs so people keep improving
  • Your numbers — monthly KPIs and sales targets. Our custom-built systems track your sessions, sales, and commissions transparently, so you always know exactly where you stand and what you’ve earned
  • The standard — safety, cleanliness, and professionalism in the club, and presenting yourself as a walking advertisement for what you coach

How You Get Paid

Most gyms pay trainers a flat rate and hope for the best. We don’t. Our compensation has three parts:

  • Base salary — your guaranteed monthly floor
  • Performance bonus — tied to your track record. Sustained performance raises your base over time — you don’t reset to zero every month
  • Sales & Execution commission — uncapped, calculated on your current month’s performance

The starting base is modest — deliberately. This role pays for output. Trainers who hit their targets consistently earn SGD $6,000–$8,000 a month, and because the base itself grows with performance history, your worst month two years in is better than your best month starting out.

Who You Are

The non-negotiables:

  • A recognized Personal Training certification.
  • You’re comfortable selling. Not tolerating sales — comfortable. You see introducing a PT package to someone who needs it as coaching, not pestering.
  • A growth mindset in the literal sense: you want feedback, you act on it, and you’re building a career, not passing time between other plans.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — you can make a nervous first-time gym-goer feel at home within ten minutes.
  • First Aid + AED certification, or willingness to obtain it.

Strongly preferred:

  • Fitness industry experience — though motivated entry-level candidates with the right attitude are welcome.
  • Group class coaching experience.
  • A track record of hitting sales or performance targets, in fitness or anywhere else. If you’ve been the top performer somewhere, tell us.

This Role Is NOT For You If…

  • You want a fixed salary that stays the same whether you perform or not.
  • You think sales is beneath a "real" coach. Here, selling well is how you earn the right to coach more people.
  • You’re counting hours. We’re counting results.
  • You need someone to chase you to follow up with your own leads and clients.
  • You see this as a stopgap. We invest heavily in our people — we’d rather invest in someone who’s staying.

What We Offer

  • A commission structure with real upside
  • A base salary that grows with your track record — performance compounds instead of resetting every month.
  • Funded education and development — certifications, courses, and mentorship. If it makes you a better coach or a better professional, we’ll usually pay for it.
  • Custom-built tech systems that track your sessions, sales, and commissions transparently — no disputes, no guesswork about what you’re owed.
  • 13th month Annual Wage Supplement.
  • Workplace insurance coverage.
  • Complimentary gym membership across all Snap Fitness clubs.
  • A team where being exceptional is noticed, rewarded, and promoted — not resented.

Application Process

Application:

  • Share your CV or LinkedIn, including your certifications.
  • A short note (3–5 sentences) answering: tell us about a target you hit — in fitness, sales, sport, or anything else — and what it took to hit it.

Interview Round:

  • Shortlisted candidates come in for an in-person interview at the club. We’ll send you a brief beforehand — come prepared.

Job Summary:

The Care Partner is a support care provider who functions under the direction of the Registered Nurse. The Care Partner primary focus will be to promote a positive patient experience by partnering with the nurse, physician, healthcare team and other healthcare providers to provide excellence in patient experience; and assist with daily living activities and comfort measures. The Care Partner assists other health care providers with safe, age appropriate and culturally aware care by performing basic patient care functions; i.e. ADL's, ambulation, and vital signs. The Care Partner may require approved advanced technical training skills may be required i.e. phlebotomy, simple treatments, dressing changes, oral suctioning, and discontinuing Foley catheters. Performing additional advanced skills may be required to support clinical care and will fluctuate depending on the needs of the unit. Performing clerical functions such as: retrieval of data, maintaining unit supplies, and transporting supplies/patient medications will be required. The Care Partner must be able to work in a fast-paced environment which requires multi-tasking and effective communication with the Registered Nurse and ancillary team. Must be able to perform under stressful conditions with a compassionate, respectful and service mindset. Must be able to take direction from a variety of care providers. Must be organized with excellent communication skills.

Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Excellence in Patient Experience by partnering with health care team, patient and family. Patient Centered Care-Clinical Practice: Supports an environment of healing or wellness for patients which includes: addressing patient needs, following the plan of care as assigned or instructed by a licensed professional; and while carrying out role responsibilities, engages the patient and family in compliance with the treatment plan. Effectively contributes to the plan of care or treatment based on assigned tasks and patient/family input in collaboration with the healthcare team with a focus on the care continuum. Consistently implements all safety interventions to minimize risk in achievement of intended outcomes. Protects rights and dignity of patient. Maintains confidentiality adhering to HIPAA regulations and recommended privacy procedures. Participates in hourly patient rounding. Answers telephone and call lights promptly, professionally and notifies appropriate individual of need for follow-up. Resolves patient concerns or escalates to the charge nurse if unable to resolve patient concerns. Proactively offers assistance and comfort measures to patients and families. Present self in positive and professional manner and show sensitivity to concerns and needs of others. Patient Centered Care Provides patient care under the direction of the RN. Provides patient care needs (ex. hygiene, nutrition, elimination, physical comfort measures) and additional advanced skills based on unit specific requirements (ex. phlebotomy, EKG, removal of foley catheters and removal of IVs). Answers telephone and call lights promptly, professionally and notifies appropriate individual of need for follow-up. Assist RN and other members of health care team with care delivery as assigned. Assist in direct patient admission. Monitors data entry for key patient safety information. Participates in charge reconciliation. Performs audits as requested. Teamwork Supports initiatives of the Health care team. Participates in unit performance improvement initiatives. Supports professional nursing practice through shared leadership, evidenced-based practice and ethical accountability. Transports unit supplies, patient care supplies, medications and equipment as assigned. Practices accountability. Communication Uses effective written and oral communication skills with patients, staff, physicians, family and visitors, i.e. AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explain, Thank you). Uses safety communication techniques, i.e. Ask a question, Request a change, Voice a concern, Use chain of command when necessary (ARRC). Communicates completion of assignment/duties to RN or Charge Nurse. Documents completion of patient care in EMR (Electronic Medical Record). Communicates patient care concerns/problems/emergencies to the RN or Charge Nurse in a timely manner. Real time communication is required. Uses positive and respectful communication with all members of healthcare team, patients and families. Maintains equipment i.e. blood pressure machines, glucometers, and other patient care equipment. When devices are not properly working sequester, tag, and report to appropriate personnel. Communicates with patient and updates white boards with information. Knowledgeable, maintains, and acts as unit expert regarding patient care documentation tools related to their role in the event of downtime. Safety and Infection Control Provides a safe environment for the provision of patient care. Consistent use of proper hand hygiene. Keeps patient rooms and unit areas clean and free of clutter. Follows appropriate PPE/Infection control policies in between patient care and equipment usage. Reinforces the importance of universal precautions with patient and patients family. Utilizes proper body mechanics, patient safe handling devices (i.e. lifts, transfer equipment, etc.), and additional assistive devices (i.e. walkers, gait belts). Performs environment of care rounds. Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

Graduation from a State approved program for Certified Nursing Assistants or Patient Care Tech Program Upon Hire Preferred

N/A

title: Furniture Technician
description:
We inspire purpose-filled living that brings joy to the modern home. With a team of more than 8,000 associates spanning 130 store and distribution locations across the U.S. and Canada, we achieve together, drive results and innovate to inspire. Drawn together by a shared passion for our customers and a spirit of fun, we deliver high-quality home furnishings that are expertly designed, responsibly sourced and bring beauty and function to people’s homes. From the day we opened our first store in Chicago in 1962 to the digital innovations that engage millions of customers today, our iconic brand is nearly 60 years in the making—and our story is still unfolding.

The Furniture Technician ensures all furniture, whether in customer homes, stores, or the warehouse, meets company standards through skilled, complex repairs and proper installation of required parts. The role maintains organized tools and materials, adheres to safety and OSHA protocols, and supports housekeeping and cross-department needs to keep operations running smoothly. title: Project Coordinator / Interior Designer
description:
We are looking for a Project Coordinator / Interior Designer to join our team and support our renovation and interior fit-out projects.

The successful candidate will be involved in both interior design and project/site coordination, from initial site measurement and design planning through to project completion and handover.

This position is suitable for candidates who enjoy a combination of design work and hands-on site management.

Fresh graduates and newcomers to the renovation industry are welcome to apply. Training and guidance will be provided.

This position offers a basic salary with an attractive commission-based incentive structure, where additional earnings will be tied to projects secured, sales performance, and successful project completion. Candidates who are proactive in handling clients, supporting quotations, bringing in new projects, and managing projects effectively will have the opportunity to earn higher overall income based on their performance and contribution to the company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate renovation and interior fit-out projects from commencement to completion.

  • Ensure works are carried out according to approved drawings, specifications and project requirements.
  • Prepare and monitor project schedules and work sequences.
  • Coordinate different trades including carpentry, tiling, ceiling, partition, painting, electrical and plumbing works.

  • Attend project and site meetings when required.
  • Prepare progress updates, site photographs and basic project documentation.
  • Assist with selection of materials, finishes, laminates, tiles, colours, sanitary fittings and other interior finishes.
  • Coordinate design requirements with actual site conditions before works commence.
  • Assist with quotations, variation works and project documentation when required.
  • Assist with project handover, defect rectification and completion works.

Requirements

  • Diploma or relevant qualification in Interior Design, Architecture, Project Management, Building, Construction or related field.
  • Fresh graduates and candidates new to the renovation industry are welcome to apply.
  • Experience in renovation, interior fit-out or construction will be an advantage but is not compulsory.
  • Able to use SketchUp for 3D interior design and space planning.
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD or other design software will be an advantage.
  • Able or willing to learn how to read construction and interior drawings.
  • Willing to learn renovation site coordination and project management.
  • Comfortable working both in the office and at project sites.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Able to communicate and coordinate with clients, workers, subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Responsible, organised and detail-oriented.
  • Good problem-solving attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Able to manage tasks independently after training and guidance.
  • Willing to travel to different project sites within Singapore.
  • Possession of a valid Singapore driving licence will be an advantage.


Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is creative, responsible and willing to learn.

This is not purely an office-based interior design position. The candidate should be interested in learning how renovation projects are actually carried out on-site and developing practical knowledge of construction and renovation works.

You will have the opportunity to gain experience in:

  • Interior design and SketchUp presentation
  • Site measurement and space planning
  • Renovation project coordination
  • Managing workers and subcontractors
  • Material and supplier coordination
  • Client communication
  • Project scheduling

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Overview of the Role:

We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Senior Product Owner to own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for our Sportsbook back-end platform. You will be the primary product authority for your domain - defining the vision, setting priorities, and driving outcomes across engineering, operations, and business stakeholders. This is not a supporting role; you will lead independently, make high-impact decisions, and be accountable for measurable results.

You will work closely with development teams, business stakeholders, data analysts, and external partners to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality sportsbook solutions. Deep familiarity with back-end systems and the gambling industry is expected, not optional.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the product roadmap for the Sportsbook back-end domain end-to-end - from discovery through delivery and post-launch optimisation - with full accountability for outcomes and KPIs.

  • Define and drive product vision for your domain, aligning engineering teams, business stakeholders, and leadership around a clear and compelling direction.

  • Lead product discovery independently, including hypothesis generation, requirements gathering, scoping, and solution design in collaboration with engineering, data, and design teams.

  • Own and maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog, making autonomous prioritisation decisions based on business value, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and strategic goals.

  • Author high-quality product specifications - detailed user stories with clear acceptance criteria, edge case handling, and visual aids (wireframes, flowcharts, sequence diagrams) - ensuring development teams have everything they need to deliver.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, operations, compliance and external partners, acting as the single point of accountability for your product area.

  • Define and track success metrics for all initiatives, owning the measurement framework and iterating based on data and live product performance.

  • Oversee UAT and release readiness, setting quality standards and ensuring new features meet functional, regulatory, and performance expectations before launch.

  • Represent the product in stakeholder forums, including leadership reviews, sprint demos, and external partner discussions, communicating progress, risks, and decisions with confidence.

  • Maintain product documentation and internal wikis to a high standard, ensuring they reflect the current state of the platform and are accessible to all relevant teams.

  • Continuously assess the live product, proactively identifying gaps, degradations, and improvement opportunities - and driving resolution without waiting to be asked.

  • Mentor and support junior Product Owners, sharing domain knowledge, reviewing their output, and raising the overall quality of product practice within the team.

What You'll Bring:

Must

  • 5+ years of Product Owner or Product Manager experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity owning a product domain independently.

  • Proven track record of owning a product roadmap and delivering measurable business outcomes - not just managing a backlog, but driving strategy and results.

  • Deep expertise in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and cross-team dependency management in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior leadership, aligning cross-functional teams, and navigating competing priorities.

  • Data-driven decision-making, with experience defining KPIs, analysing product metrics, and using data to inform prioritisation and iteration.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable product decisions.

Desirable but Not Required

  • Strong understanding of back-end systems architecture, distributed microservices, databases, and API-driven ecosystems, with the ability to translate technical concepts into product decisions and stakeholder value.

  • Familiarity with back-end systems in sports betting, including bet placement/settlement, real-time data processing, risk management, regulatory compliance and external integrations.

  • A personal passion for sports or sports betting can be an added advantage, as it helps understand user needs and industry trends.

Along with comprehensive benefits, we offer GROW Points—a unique rewards system that celebrates your hard work and dedication. You’ll also enjoy perks like exclusive Skechers shoe discounts, early paycheck access, and more!

Position Summary:

The Dining Server is responsible for delivering an exceptional dining experience for residents and guests by providing courteous and efficient table service, maintaining high standards of cleanliness and food safety, and ensuring dining areas are welcoming and sanitary. This role supports daily meal service as well as special events, assists with food preparation and cost control, and collaborates with team members to uphold Cedarhurst’s dining standards. The Dining Server also communicates effectively with residents and families, responds to individual dining needs, and contributes to a safe and positive environment that reflects the company’s commitment to quality service and resident wellbeing.

Essential Functions:

  • Assist with catering, room service, special events, and marketing functions, ensuring smooth execution and resident satisfaction.
  • Promptly take food and beverage orders and deliver service to residents and guests in a courteous, accurate, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain a clean and sanitary work area by washing pots, pans, and utensils used in meal preparation, following all food safety standards.
  • Clear, sanitize, and reset tables; dispose of trash and clean containers; and complete daily checklists to ensure kitchen and dining areas are consistently maintained.
  • Assist with cleaning dining areas, including floors, tables, and chairs after meals and events, and ensure sweeping, vacuuming, and mopping are completed at the end of each shift.
  • Maintain knowledge of assigned responsibilities and adapt service to meet individual resident dining preferences and needs.
  • Support cost-control efforts by minimizing waste and using supplies responsibly.
  • Accurately follow recipes and ingredient labels to ensure proper preparation and consistency of food and beverages.
  • Safely operate, maintain, and clean kitchen equipment and utensils in accordance with safety guidelines.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of dining menus and effectively communicate menu details to residents and guests.
  • Prepare and maintain table settings to meet Cedarhurst’s established dining standards and create a welcoming atmosphere.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations (FDA, state, county, local) and ensure full adherence to all food handling and sanitation guidelines.
  • Follow Cedarhurst infection control guidelines and uphold safety standards to protect residents, guests, and staff.
  • Apply basic math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions) to accurately perform dining-related tasks.
  • Communicate effectively with residents, families, and staff to support positive relationships and ensure residents’ physical, personal, and emotional wellbeing.
  • Collaborate with team members, follow management direction, and demonstrate initiative in resolving conflicts and promoting a respectful, supportive dining environment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Up to two years of prior experience preferred, with senior living experience strongly desired.
  • Relevant state or county licensure preferred, with the ability to obtain licensure if required by the state in which employed.
  • CPR or BLS certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in common digital tools and applications, including Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Excel, Word), web-based platforms, electronic health record systems, and any HR-related systems as applicable.

Working Conditions:

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.

Cedarhurst considers the health and safety of its residents, family members, and team members as its highest priorities. All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, participation in required health assessments (such as TB testing or physical evaluations), and the use of designated personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by company policy and applicable law.

The Chief Engineer for Strategic Systems is an autonomous technical leader responsible for the end-to-end mission success of solid rocket propulsion system programs by managing large multidisciplinary teams, overseeing complex systems engineering processes, and aligning technical execution with budgetary and schedule requirements.

The position reports to the Director of Engineering and is part of the Strategic Systems department based in Reno, NV. This role is based in Reno, NV or Folsom, CA or Huntsville, AL or Long Beach, CA or Remote.

In this role, the essential functions are:

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

  1. Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other relevant engineering discipline with 15 years of engineering experience and 5+ years in technical leadership in solid rocket motors (SRMs)
  2. Able to direct the end-to-end technical lifecycle of the program by leading cross-functional teams through rigorous design reviews and qualification milestones, ensuring that the final system is producible, compliant with technical data requirements, and balanced against cost and schedule constraints.

Has served as the primary technical spokesperson for a program, managing both internal and external stakeholder relationships by presenting programmatic material, cultivating new business, and ensuring all customer requests remain within authorized scope while providing data-driven technical alternatives for collaborative decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. At least four years of experience leading controllable solid rocket propulsion system projects consisting of high-performing multi-disciplinary teams of no less than 10 people
  2. Current DoD Secret Security clearance

title: Regional Director of Operations (KY, IL, IN, MO)
description:
Position Summary:

The Regional Director of Operations (RDO), reporting directly to the Divisional Director of Operations, provides strategic operational leadership to assigned senior living communities. The RDO is responsible for driving performance outcomes, strengthening community leadership teams, ensuring regulatory compliance, optimizing financial operations, and upholding the organization’s standards for resident experience and service excellence. This role serves as a key resource and advisor to Executive Directors, supporting efficient operations, high-quality service delivery, and long-term community success.


This role requires frequent weekly travel across assigned communities and includes an auto and phone allowance.


Why Work for Cedarhurst:

  • At Cedarhurst, our core values guide how we work together and how we care for those we serve. We expect every team member to be passionate, trustworthy, empathetic, positive, respectful, and approachable. Being part of Cedarhurst means making a meaningful difference every day.
  • We believe our team is our greatest strength. That’s why we invest in comprehensive training, as well as opportunities for both personal and professional growth. We’re committed to promoting from within and supporting team members who want to build their careers with us.
  • Cedarhurst offers a competitive benefits package, including medical insurance, life insurance, long-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan with company match (after one year of service) for eligible employees.
  • Work that makes a difference in the lives of our residents and community
  • Access to our St. Louis Home Office, which includes an on-site gym with brand new equipment, personal training, group classes, and stretching sessions (for visiting or office-based team members)
  • Catered lunches and regular team events at our Home Office
  • Auto and phone allowance to support you in a mobile, travel-based role
  • Meaningful opportunities to build relationships with residents, families, and team members across multiple communities

Essential Duties:

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • Assist Executive Directors in assigned communities with development of their management teams, including interviewing, hiring, training, and coaching/counseling.
  • Support Executive Directors in meeting or exceeding budgeted occupancy goals by ensuring communities are always tour-ready, completing post-tour follow-ups, and holding the Director of Sales accountable.
  • Oversee each community’s satisfaction survey process and partner with Executive Directors to achieve the highest possible satisfaction levels.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and confirm each community remains in compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Conduct monthly budget variance reviews with each community.
  • Review each community’s spend-down sheet/DOMO report at least once weekly and communicate variances and resolutions to the DDO in a timely manner.
  • Conduct routine community visits and use site visit checklists. Conduct timely follow-up with the Executive Director and/or other department heads to make sure deficiencies are addressed, working with other departments as needed.
  • Oversee open positions in each assigned community. Ensure each department leader is filling their open positions in a timely manner and with the right candidates. Monitor time-to-fill data and turnover rates in each assigned community.
  • Conduct onboarding and orientation with new Executive Directors thoroughly ensuring that their onboarding experience is positive and informational. Conduct follow-up training when needed.
  • Provide leadership consistent with key servant-leadership principles, including effective listening, empathy, awareness, and persuasion.
  • Ensure that all Executive Directors are following the communication expectations policy, while also adhering to the policy themselves.
  • Educate Executive Directors on using DOMO and related systems to identify opportunities early and implement effective solutions.
  • Perform conflict intervention and resolution for customers, families, employees, and other impacted parties while practicing company mission and core values.
  • Travel as needed, up to four (4) days per week; overnight travel may be required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Education and/or Experience:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field, OR 9+ years of relevant operational leadership experience.
  • Applicable state licensure or certification as required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of senior housing operations experience with proven leadership and organizational skills.
  • Experience supervising Executive Directors and providing operational direction across multiple communities.
  • Must possess clear knowledge of assisted living, memory care, and independent living regulations in all states within the assigned region.
  • Strong understanding of department functions within senior living communities, including housekeeping, resident care, maintenance, dietary, and business office operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and work effectively with older adults.
  • Demonstrated experience in staffing, team development, and retention.
  • Ability to remain calm in stressful situations, adapt to frequent interruptions, and manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong respect for resident rights, confidentiality, and high service standards.
  • Exceptional organizational and project-management skills; self-starter with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills and sound judgment aligned with the company’s mission, values, and safety priorities.
  • High level of customer service, hospitality, curiosity, and professionalism when interacting with residents, families, employees, and visitors.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), internet browsers (Chrome, Edge, Internet Explorer), Welcome Home CRM, and electronic medical record platforms.

Working Conditions:

As part of The Dover Company’s commitment to providing outstanding care and support, the company ensures that staff work under conditions that prioritize safety, collaboration, and professional growth. The conditions listed below define the experience of working in the Home Office or remotely.

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to two hundred (200) pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

description:
• An exciting Senior Product role within the Qantas Loyalty Financial Services Tribe
  • Define the product roadmap for digital products in conjunction with the Loyalty Leadership team
  • Permanent full-time role based at Mascot Head Office

Qantas has always been dedicated to going above and beyond for their customers – both in the air, and on the ground and at Qantas Loyalty; we’re a huge part of that commitment. By taking the time to recognise and reward our members, we build stronger relationships with the people who matter most.

As the Senior Product Manager Financial Services, you will have a broad and complex set of responsibilities across your diversified product portfolio. As the leading Product Manager for Qantas Pay, you will have deep domain knowledge of the business vertical in which the Tribe operates, and you are accountable for discovering new propositions, and driving growth to deliver outstanding customer experiences. You will lead a team of Product Managers and Business Analysts, manage the product portfolio, be the subject matter expert for innovation and product practices, identify and form new strategic partnerships as well as on-going transformation of organisational and people capabilities in your team.

This role requires deep subject matter expertise and exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills. Key to the success of this role is to form strong relationships within and outside the Qantas group.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of senior product leadership experience in large, complex matrix organisation with at least 3 years as the top-level owner of a distinct product or product line
  • Experience in everyday banking products or financial services
  • Experience in the delivery of large scale and complex transformation and change programs across multiple business units
  • Experience in driving results in a fast-paced and continually changing environment
  • Experience leading medium to large multi-disciplinary teams, building a team oriented, collaborative, agile environment
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate, contribute and create effective teamwork across traditional organisational boundaries as well as lean agile organisations
  • Post graduate qualifications in business highly advantageous (e.g MBA) or Tertiary qualifications in technology, business or a related discipline
  • Significant leadership experience and domain knowledge
  • Strategy development and execution
  • Deep knowledge in customer and product discovery, implementation and measurement processes
  • Business cases development and product portfolio performance management
  • Senior executive level stakeholder management skills with ability to influence/negotiate positive outcomes

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel:

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – apply today!

Silvus is seeking a Linux System and Security Analyst to analyze, troubleshoot, automate, and conduct CyberSecurity activities based on Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) and maintain the company’s IT infrastructure. title: Lead Engineer - United Kingdom
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Position Summary:

The Dining Server is responsible for delivering an exceptional dining experience for residents and guests by providing courteous and efficient table service, maintaining high standards of cleanliness and food safety, and ensuring dining areas are welcoming and sanitary. This role supports daily meal service as well as special events, assists with food preparation and cost control, and collaborates with team members to uphold Cedarhurst’s dining standards. The Dining Server also communicates effectively with residents and families, responds to individual dining needs, and contributes to a safe and positive environment that reflects the company’s commitment to quality service and resident wellbeing.


Essential Functions:

  • Assist with catering, room service, special events, and marketing functions, ensuring smooth execution and resident satisfaction.
  • Promptly take food and beverage orders and deliver service to residents and guests in a courteous, accurate, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain a clean and sanitary work area by washing pots, pans, and utensils used in meal preparation, following all food safety standards.
  • Clear, sanitize, and reset tables; dispose of trash and clean containers; and complete daily checklists to ensure kitchen and dining areas are consistently maintained.
  • Assist with cleaning dining areas, including floors, tables, and chairs after meals and events, and ensure sweeping, vacuuming, and mopping are completed at the end of each shift.
  • Maintain knowledge of assigned responsibilities and adapt service to meet individual resident dining preferences and needs.
  • Support cost-control efforts by minimizing waste and using supplies responsibly.
  • Accurately follow recipes and ingredient labels to ensure proper preparation and consistency of food and beverages.
  • Safely operate, maintain, and clean kitchen equipment and utensils in accordance with safety guidelines.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of dining menus and effectively communicate menu details to residents and guests.
  • Prepare and maintain table settings to meet Cedarhurst’s established dining standards and create a welcoming atmosphere.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations (FDA, state, county, local) and ensure full adherence to all food handling and sanitation guidelines.
  • Follow Cedarhurst infection control guidelines and uphold safety standards to protect residents, guests, and staff.
  • Apply basic math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions) to accurately perform dining-related tasks.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Up to two years of prior experience preferred, with senior living experience strongly desired.
  • Relevant state or county licensure preferred, with the ability to obtain licensure if required by the state in which employed.
  • CPR or BLS certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in common digital tools and applications, including Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Excel, Word), web-based platforms, electronic health record systems, and any HR-related systems as applicable.

Working Conditions:

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.

Cedarhurst considers the health and safety of its residents, family members, and team members as its highest priorities. title: QNB3619 - Assistant Vice President, Data Science
description:
Job Summary

The data scientist plays a crucial role in driving advanced analytics and AI initiatives across the bank. This role collaborates closely with business and operational leaders to provide expert support, leveraging data analytical and AI tools to deliver strategic insights and actionable recommendations. Through hypothesis based analysis to machine learning (ML) projects and applying Large Language Models, the data scientist models complex business problems using a variety of techniques including predictive or prescriptive analytics, deep learning, GenAI and visualization. Additionally, they support senior leadership by overseeing the development of business insights, reports, and AI capabilities to inform decision making processes and drive impactful outcomes.

Main Responsibilities
  • Shareholder & Financial: Implement KPIs and monitor the performance of Data & AI driven solutions to measure impact on business outcomes. Promote cost consciousness and efficiency in Data Analytics and AI projects to minimize expenses and maximize returns. Implement KRIs and manage the Group's exposure to Data & AI related risk effectively. Coordinate and obtain approval from the EVP Data & Analytics for projects and new systems that would impact capital or operating expenditures. Take part in the overall QNB Data & Analytics strategy execution. Communicate comprehensive and cost effective Data, Analytics & AI solutions to user requirements while keeping in mind the Group's budgets and targets.
  • Customer (Internal & External): Collaborate closely with peers, key divisional stakeholders, and third party support teams to identify and implement advanced data driven and AI solutions that deliver substantial value for QNB and its customers. Translate complex business needs into comprehensive data science and analytics requirements to support strategic business decision making. Provide strategic guidance regarding the potential and implementation of AI and data science within the organization. Assist customers with thorough and insightful responses to their inquiries about the Bank's products and strive to provide innovative solutions to their requests. Ensure activities are conducted in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments and units to achieve significant improvements in turnaround times. Build and maintain robust and effective relationships with related departments and units to achieve the Group's overarching objectives. Provide precise and timely data to external and internal auditors, compliance teams, financial control, and risk management when required.
  • Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): Develop predictive models using advanced machine learning techniques to extract meaningful insights. Research and implement cutting edge techniques and tools in data analytics and artificial intelligence to streamline data analysis processes and enhance decision making. Identify and implement new statistical or mathematical methodologies as required for specific data driven projects. Build robust data driven models to address complex business questions and employ large scale experimentation, analysis, and visualization techniques to generate efficient and repeatable insights. Integrate domain knowledge into AI solutions, such as leveraging financial risk data, customer journey analytics, quality predictions, and sales and marketing data. Continuously monitor the performance and health of AI driven models, ensuring high quality outputs and efficiency. Establish best practices for AI development and production infrastructure, including cloud computing, Spark, GPU utilization, and containerization. Design and conduct analytics with the highest standards of model validation, accuracy, encompassing study design, methodology, algorithms, and statistical modelling.
  • Learning & Knowledge: Ensure a comprehensive understanding of business requirements to deliver the most effective data, analytics, and AI solutions. Possess detailed knowledge of system architecture and limitations to determine optimal problem solving methods. Understand user requirements and existing data structures to provide appropriate solutions by enhancing existing systems or implementing new ones. Stay updated with methodologies, tools, and industry trends in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data analytics. Proactively identify areas for professional development in data science and undertake relevant development activities. Seek out opportunities to stay current with advancements in AI and data analytics fields. Initiate regular meetings within the Application Development department focused on discussing progress, resolving issues, and addressing concerns related to AI and data analytics projects.
  • Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: Adhere to all pertinent legal, regulatory, and internal compliance requirements, including but not limited to policies on Data Protection, Fraud Control, and Anti Money Laundering (AML) & Counter Terrorist Financing (CTF). Understand and effectively perform your role within the Three Lines of Defence framework to identify, measure, monitor, manage, and report risks related to data, analytics, and AI projects. Ensure optimal outcomes for clients in line with Conduct Risk policy by leveraging AI and analytics tools ethically and responsibly. Support the Risk and Control Self Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRI), incident reporting, and remediation processes, as applicable, in accordance with Operational Risk Management guidelines specific to data and AI initiatives. Complete all mandatory training provided by the organization to achieve and maintain the required levels of competence in data science, analytics, and AI fields. Attend all required (internal and external) seminars and workshops, as instructed, to stay abreast of the latest advancements and best practices in data analytics and AI.
  • Other: Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard all data and systems. Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer data and internal information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. Maintain high professional standards to uphold the organization's reputation and to strengthen its leadership position in data analytics and AI. All other ad hoc duties/activities related to data analytics and AI that management might request from time to time.
Education and Experience Requirements
  • University graduate preferably with a major in computer science, data science, software engineering, information systems, or a related quantitative field.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience, preferably within a Data Scientist or related role.
  • A PhD in statistics, ML, computer science, or the natural sciences, especially physics or any engineering discipline or equivalent, would be desirable.
  • Candidates must have a specialization in ML, AI, cognitive science, or data science, with extensive hands on experience in developing data science and AI solutions using machine learning, deep learning, and LLM techniques.
  • Sound knowledge and implementation experience on LLM based solutions.
  • Prior experience in banking is desirable.
  • Sound knowledge in cloud technologies, Python, and full stack engineering is required.

  • Resume/CV
  • Copy of Passport or QID
  • Copy of Education Certificate

title: Robotics Software Developer
description:
Promise Robotics is pioneering Physical AI for homebuilding — a rapidly growing, venture-backed company bringing together AI, robotics, and manufacturing to help the homebuilding industry meet the growing demand for housing. Our robotic systems, built and operated inside AI-powered factories, give the industry the production capacity, consistency, and speed to build more high-quality homes than traditional methods allow. Our team spans AI researchers and roboticists to factory operators, technicians, and production teams — all building the future of homebuilding together.

We'rebuilding physical AI for housing — and unlike most of the field, our robots are already in production, fabricating real structures and generating real operational data every day across multiple factories.

We’re looking for a Robotics Software Developer to join our team and contribute to developing cutting-edgesolutions for our core robotic manufacturing technologies. This is an early-career role for someone with strong fundamentals and hands-on robotics project experience who wants to develop it in production.

Why join us?

  • Purpose-Driven Work: Contribute to projects with significant social, economic, and environmental impact.

What you’ll do:

  • Build andmaintainsimulation scenes — set up and extend simulation environments and test scenarios that mirror our production cells.

  • Write clean, tested code — produce well-documented C++ and Python, backed by unit and integration tests.
  • Debug integration issues — help troubleshoot software–hardware issues alongside the robotics and hardware teams.
  • Participate in the team's practices — contribute to code reviews, agile ceremonies, and CI pipelines.

title: Retail Assistant PT Zaandam
description:
Wat bieden wij?

Jij staat centraal in alles wat we doen. We bieden je de juiste omgeving om te groeien en je talenten te benutten. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn speciaal voor jou ontworpen:

• Een uurloon tussen de €8,69 en €16,39 (afhankelijk van leeftijd)
• Een vaste personeelskorting van 15% (gevaarlijk verleidelijk, we know)
• Vakantietoeslag van 8% en vakantiedagen volgens de cao Retail Non-Food
• Een collectiviteitskorting op je aanvullende zorgverzekering
• Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Detailhandel
• Toegang tot ons Let’s Talk-programma, met gratis en vertrouwelijke ondersteuning voor jou en je huisgenoten, 24/7 beschikbaar voor o.a. mentaal welzijn en praktische vragen
• Leuke extra’s via Benefits at Work, met aantrekkelijke kortingen op o.a. mode, elektronica, wonen en dagjes uit

Wat je doet als een Retail Assistant

Als Retail Assistant maak je elke dag mensen blij. Zo ziet dat eruit in de praktijk:

  • Je biedt klanten een geweldige ervaring terwijl je ze helpt met onderwerpen als maten of stijlen, aankopen of retourzendingen
  • Je zorgt voor een nette werkvloer met volle planken, nette paskamers en de nieuwste mode. Ook houd je het magazijn opgeruimd en goed georganiseerd
  • Je biedt een snelle, vriendelijke, efficiënte ervaring bij de kassa's en je verwerkt verzoeken, annuleringen en retouren.
  • Je ontvangt nieuwe leveringen, pakt ze uit en controleert ze. Je plaatst onze producten op de winkelvloer en zorgt ervoor dat ze allemaal juist geprijsd zijn. Tegelijkertijd zorg je ervoor dat alles aan onze hoge eisen voldoet

Wat wij van jou vragen:

  • Je werkt graag met mensen en creëert graag positieve ervaringen
  • Je bent eerlijk, een sterke communicator die ook kan luisteren, ideeën kan delen en inspringt waar nodig
  • Je hebt goede organisatorische vaardigheden en aandacht voor details
  • Je bent een zeer gemotiveerde teamspeler met een positieve houding en de bereidheid om te leren
  • Je bent geïnteresseerd in mode en de nieuwste looks
  • dealiter heb je enige ervaring met het werken in een drukke winkelomgeving

Onze mode is niet one-size-fits-all, en onze cultuur ook niet. Bij Primark stimuleren we gelijke kansen op de werkvloer en streven we ernaar een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waar alle collega's zichzelf kunnen zijn, kansen krijgen en samen kunnen groeien.

Over Primark:

Bij Primark staan mensen centraal. Zij zijn het kloppende hart van ons bedrijf en de reden waarom we zijn gegroeid van onze eerste winkel in Dublin in 1969 tot een bedrijf met een omzet van meer dan £9 miljard, meer dan 80.000 collega’s en meer dan 440 winkels in 18 landen.

Onze waarden vormen de kern van alles wat we doen:
We zijn Caring: we zetten mensen altijd op de eerste plaats.
We zijn Dynamic: we blijven in beweging en verleggen grenzen om vooruitstrevend te blijven.
We zijn Together: samen bereiken we meer dan alleen.

Onze mode is niet one-size-fits-all, en onze cultuur ook niet. Bij Primark stimuleren we gelijke kansen op de werkvloer en streven we ernaar een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waar alle collega's zichzelf kunnen zijn, kansen krijgen en samen kunnen groeien.

Turvallisen työpaikan suomen suurimman franchising-ravintolaketjun yksikössä Mukavan työn rennon ilmapiirin omaavassa ravintolassa Esihenkilöt, jotka perehdyttävät työnkuvaan ja tukevat työssä onnistumisessa

title: Lead Data Analytics Platforms | Perth, Brisbane
description:
About BHP

At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.

About the Role

BHP is generating large amounts of data from different sources and envisioning to scale value and impact through delivery of emergent data, AI and agentic solutions. Reporting to the Manager Data Platforms, your task as a Lead Data Platforms is to lead a team in providing expertise in the design, implementation and continuous improvements of BHP’s core Data & AI platforms – in particular focusing in on core data and knowledge capabilities to ingest, engineer, model and contextualise data.

You will lead a team of BHP Platform Engineers/Product Owners and a contingent of operational contractors (onshore and offshore) to deliver a quality service to our customers.

These platforms provide re-usable, scalable, and self-service capabilities enabling project teams and customer groups to leverage data, analytics, and AI to drive business value and decision making.

Through a diverse range of engagements, you will bring your expertise in modern data, knowledge and AI technologies to guide, operate and improve enterprise platforms across a portfolio of products.

About You

  • You are a strategic and hands-on leader with a strong drive for continuous learning and adapting to emerging technologies across data and AI platforms.
  • You bring deep expertise in modern data and cloud technologies and can translate strategy into scalable platform outcomes.
  • You are an excellent communicator who can guide and influence stakeholders across business and technology domains.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Extensive experience in data engineering or data platform engineering roles, with leadership responsibility. Strong experience with modern cloud-based data platforms including data warehouses, data lakes, integration platforms and analytics tooling.
  • Experience leading platform portfolios, roadmaps and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), Snowflake and modern data ecosystems.
  • Experience in source control, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • Exposure to emergent AI/ML, Agentic and Knowledge Base capabilities (e.g. Vector stores, Semantic Models and Graph databases).

    • Power BI

    • Collibra
    • Microsoft Purview
    • Neo4j

As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks.

At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. Job Summary:

The Care Partner is a support care provider who functions under the direction of the Registered Nurse. The Care Partner primary focus will be to promote a positive patient experience by partnering with the nurse, physician, healthcare team and other healthcare providers to provide excellence in patient experience; and assist with daily living activities and comfort measures. The Care Partner assists other health care providers with safe, age appropriate and culturally aware care by performing basic patient care functions; i.e. ADL's, ambulation, and vital signs. Performing clerical functions such as: retrieval of data, maintaining unit supplies, and transporting supplies/patient medications will be required. The Care Partner must be able to work in a fast-paced environment which requires multi-tasking and effective communication with the Registered Nurse and ancillary team. Must be able to perform under stressful conditions with a compassionate, respectful and service mindset. Must be able to take direction from a variety of care providers. Must be organized with excellent communication skills.

Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Excellence in Patient Experience by partnering with health care team, patient and family. Patient Centered Care-Clinical Practice: Supports an environment of healing or wellness for patients which includes: addressing patient needs, following the plan of care as assigned or instructed by a licensed professional; and while carrying out role responsibilities, engages the patient and family in compliance with the treatment plan. Effectively contributes to the plan of care or treatment based on assigned tasks and patient/family input in collaboration with the healthcare team with a focus on the care continuum. Consistently implements all safety interventions to minimize risk in achievement of intended outcomes. Protects rights and dignity of patient. Maintains confidentiality adhering to HIPAA regulations and recommended privacy procedures. Participates in hourly patient rounding. Answers telephone and call lights promptly, professionally and notifies appropriate individual of need for follow-up. Resolves patient concerns or escalates to the charge nurse if unable to resolve patient concerns. Proactively offers assistance and comfort measures to patients and families. Present self in positive and professional manner and show sensitivity to concerns and needs of others. Patient Centered Care Provides patient care under the direction of the RN. Provides patient care needs (ex. hygiene, nutrition, elimination, physical comfort measures) and additional advanced skills based on unit specific requirements (ex. phlebotomy, EKG, removal of foley catheters and removal of IVs). Answers telephone and call lights promptly, professionally and notifies appropriate individual of need for follow-up. Assist RN and other members of health care team with care delivery as assigned. Assist in direct patient admission. Monitors data entry for key patient safety information. Participates in charge reconciliation. Performs audits as requested. Teamwork Supports initiatives of the Health care team. Participates in unit performance improvement initiatives. Supports professional nursing practice through shared leadership, evidenced-based practice and ethical accountability. Transports unit supplies, patient care supplies, medications and equipment as assigned. Practices accountability. Communication Uses effective written and oral communication skills with patients, staff, physicians, family and visitors, i.e. AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explain, Thank you). Uses safety communication techniques, i.e. Ask a question, Request a change, Voice a concern, Use chain of command when necessary (ARRC). Communicates completion of assignment/duties to RN or Charge Nurse. Documents completion of patient care in EMR (Electronic Medical Record). Communicates patient care concerns/problems/emergencies to the RN or Charge Nurse in a timely manner. Real time communication is required. Uses positive and respectful communication with all members of healthcare team, patients and families. Maintains equipment i.e. blood pressure machines, glucometers, and other patient care equipment. When devices are not properly working sequester, tag, and report to appropriate personnel. Communicates with patient and updates white boards with information. Knowledgeable, maintains, and acts as unit expert regarding patient care documentation tools related to their role in the event of downtime. Safety and Infection Control Provides a safe environment for the provision of patient care. Consistent use of proper hand hygiene. Keeps patient rooms and unit areas clean and free of clutter. Follows appropriate PPE/Infection control policies in between patient care and equipment usage. Reinforces the importance of universal precautions with patient and patients family. Utilizes proper body mechanics, patient safe handling devices (i.e. lifts, transfer equipment, etc.), and additional assistive devices (i.e. walkers, gait belts). Performs environment of care rounds. Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.
