description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Join our team as a Backend AI Software Integration Engineer building a multi-tenant GenAI Security Platform that enables enterprises to benchmark, red-team, and secure LLMs and agentic workflows. In this core engineering role, you will focus predominantly on backend software development in Python—building middleware APIs, data ingestion endpoints, and integration hooks to embed Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS across enterprise AI pipelines and partner architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Backend Software & API Engineering: Design, build, and maintain high-performance, asynchronous REST/gRPC microservices, background job workers, and database schemas in Python.

  • AI Ingestion & Integration Hooks: Develop clean API endpoints, webhook receivers, and data ingestion hooks to collect, route, and inspect LLM prompts, context payloads, and agent execution logs.

  • AI Gateways & Agent Workflows: Build middleware logic and AI Gateway integrations connecting model providers and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP) with inline security controls, policy enforcement, and fallback routing.

  • Solution Architecture & Blueprints: Author technical architecture diagrams and integration blueprints documenting insertion points for the Prisma AIRS portfolio (Model, Red Teaming, Runtime, and Agent Security) within cloud and hybrid environments.

  • Automated Red-Teaming & API Exposure: Engineer programmatic execution pipelines for automated LLM probing (jailbreaks, prompt injections) and expose structured API endpoints to serve telemetry data to frontend dashboards and SIEM tools.

  • Technical Onboarding: Reviewing partner software architecture and providing documentation or SDKs to speed up integration timeline

  • Travel: This role will be based in our Texas office but will require regular travel to our Santa Clara, CA HQ

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 1+ years in Software Engineering or Systems Integration with a primary emphasis on backend development and cloud security.

  • Backend Python Depth: Production-level mastery of Python for asynchronous backend services, API frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or gRPC), and microservice architectures.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Education: BS/MS Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field or equivalent or equivalent military experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Asynchronous Systems: Strong background in distributed task queues (e.g., Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ) and event-driven backend architectures.

  • AI Security Expertise: Hands-on experience with automated AI red teaming, prompt defense tools, and securing Model Context Protocol (MCP) server interactions.

  • AI Stack Integration: Practical experience integrating LLM APIs, vector storage, and agentic protocols/frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP) via backend middleware.

  • Ecosystem Familiarity: Working knowledge of major enterprise platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Databricks, Glean)

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Senior RF Design Engineer

Senior RF Design Engineer

Location: San Diego, CA

Job Description

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Senior RF Design Engineer reporting to the Director of RF Engineering on the RF Engineering team. The successful individual in this role will actively participate in all aspects of the design process to develop the RF subsystem for Silvus’ StreamCaster MANET product line.

This position is 100% onsite, Monday through Friday, at our office in Rancho Bernardo, North San Diego, CA.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Antenna to baseband RF subsystem design using discrete circuitry or highly integrated RFICs.

  • Discrete design includes PLL, LNA, Mixers, PA etc.

  • Implementing or supervising schematic capture and PCB layout.

  • RF performance characterization, tuning, and troubleshooting.

  • Overall system design to ensure good EMI performance.

  • Ensure circuit board design and overall radio product can pass emission and immunity regulations.

  • Troubleshoot RF-related production yield problems.

  • Improve design for manufacturability.

  • Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.

  • Travel Requirement – Rare local travel, as required by Silvus (i.e. Irvine, West LA.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelors of Science (or higher) in Electrical Engineering.

  • Minimum 5 years of multi-GHz RF hardware development experience.

  • Good working knowledge of RF board layout, fabrication, and packaging.

  • Hands-on experience with solving EMI, harmonics, spurious, and stability issues.

  • Experience using RF simulation tools (i.e. AWR Microwave Office, Altium).

  • Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen, or U.S. Permanent Resident) due to clients under U.S. federal contracts.

  • All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Master of Science in Electrical Engineering.

  • Excellent bench skills.

  • Proactive approach to problem-solving.

  • Detail-oriented and a firm commitment to quality.

  • Ability to work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment.

  • Problem-solving, data analysis, deductive reasoning, and critical thinking skills.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Indoor air-conditioned facility.

  • Office environment.

  • Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.

  • Perform bending and reaching movements to place items on lower and higher shelves.

Position Summary:

The Dining Server is responsible for delivering an exceptional dining experience for residents and guests by providing courteous and efficient table service, maintaining high standards of cleanliness and food safety, and ensuring dining areas are welcoming and sanitary. This role supports daily meal service as well as special events, assists with food preparation and cost control, and collaborates with team members to uphold Cedarhurst’s dining standards. The Dining Server also communicates effectively with residents and families, responds to individual dining needs, and contributes to a safe and positive environment that reflects the company’s commitment to quality service and resident wellbeing.


Essential Functions:

  • Assist with catering, room service, special events, and marketing functions, ensuring smooth execution and resident satisfaction.
  • Promptly take food and beverage orders and deliver service to residents and guests in a courteous, accurate, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain a clean and sanitary work area by washing pots, pans, and utensils used in meal preparation, following all food safety standards.
  • Clear, sanitize, and reset tables; dispose of trash and clean containers; and complete daily checklists to ensure kitchen and dining areas are consistently maintained.
  • Assist with cleaning dining areas, including floors, tables, and chairs after meals and events, and ensure sweeping, vacuuming, and mopping are completed at the end of each shift.
  • Maintain knowledge of assigned responsibilities and adapt service to meet individual resident dining preferences and needs.
  • Support cost-control efforts by minimizing waste and using supplies responsibly.
  • Accurately follow recipes and ingredient labels to ensure proper preparation and consistency of food and beverages.
  • Safely operate, maintain, and clean kitchen equipment and utensils in accordance with safety guidelines.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of dining menus and effectively communicate menu details to residents and guests.
  • Prepare and maintain table settings to meet Cedarhurst’s established dining standards and create a welcoming atmosphere.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations (FDA, state, county, local) and ensure full adherence to all food handling and sanitation guidelines.
  • Follow Cedarhurst infection control guidelines and uphold safety standards to protect residents, guests, and staff.
  • Apply basic math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions) to accurately perform dining-related tasks.
  • Communicate effectively with residents, families, and staff to support positive relationships and ensure residents’ physical, personal, and emotional wellbeing.
  • Collaborate with team members, follow management direction, and demonstrate initiative in resolving conflicts and promoting a respectful, supportive dining environment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Up to two years of prior experience preferred, with senior living experience strongly desired.
  • Relevant state or county licensure preferred, with the ability to obtain licensure if required by the state in which employed.
  • CPR or BLS certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in common digital tools and applications, including Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Excel, Word), web-based platforms, electronic health record systems, and any HR-related systems as applicable.

Working Conditions:

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

Department Overview

This role is part of the Avigilon Platform product management team, which is responsible for developing common, enterprise-grade software and hardware foundations, including universal web playback components and edge appliances for streaming, that power solutions across the Avigilon portfolio and extend into broader Motorola Solutions ecosystems.


Job Description

As the Sr. Product Manager, Video Services, you will serve as a critical internal partner and platform product leader. In this primarily internally-facing role, you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our common web video player and underlying streaming architecture, collaborating directly with product teams across Motorola Solutions to understand their needs and deliver scalable media capabilities.

You will lead product initiatives to power video playback for the Avigilon portfolio (Alta and Unity) while extending core streaming technologies into public safety applications (CommandCentral Aware), public-private partnerships (PPP), and edge deployment models via SafetyHub appliances. Working side-by-side with engineering teams specializing in low-latency video streaming, WebCodecs, and real-time media, you will ensure our platform delivers unified, high-performing video experiences across every product line we support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Own the product strategy and execution roadmap for Motorola Solutions' common web-based video player and underlying video streaming services.

  • Cross-Ecosystem Integration: Bridge video streaming capabilities between enterprise security platforms (Avigilon Unity and Avigilon Alta), enterprise resilience solutions, and public safety environments (i.e. MSI Aware) to enable seamless video delivery across domain boundaries.

  • Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) & Edge Streaming: Define product requirements and streaming approaches for public-private partnership workflows and edge deployment models, including integration with SafetyHub appliances.

  • Core Web Player Strategy: Collaborate with engineering teams to guide feature development for our modular, Web Component-based web player—including real-time live streaming, low-latency playback, interactive PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) camera controls, synchronized timeline playback, snapshot features, and multi-user spectator modes.

  • Tech Stack Alignment: Evaluate emerging video technologies, protocols, and APIs (such as WebCodecs, WebRTC, HLS.js, and SignalR) to ensure our streaming infrastructure meets strict requirements for performance, scaling, low latency, and cross-browser support.

  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with UX, customer-facing product managers, solution architects, and public safety stakeholders to gather requirements, validate feature specs, and drive adoption across product lines.

Are you ready to shape sterility assurance strategy with a strong North America regulatory focus while influencing manufacturing quality across the Novartis network? As the Senior Director, Global Sterility Assurance, you will set sterility assurance and aseptic processing standards with primary accountability for aligning U.S. manufacturing operations to FDA expectations. Partnering closely with senior leaders across Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Technical Operations, you will drive inspection readiness, strengthen aseptic capabilities, and guide complex, cross-platform initiatives. This role blends deep technical expertise with enterprise leadership—protecting product quality, safeguarding patient supply in the U.S., and enabling consistent sterility assurance excellence globally.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead sterility assurance strategy with primary focus on U.S. manufacturing and FDA regulatory expectations.
  • Drive North America/U.S. inspection readiness and remediation programs, partnering with sites to prevent repeat observations.
  • Serve as Global Process Owner for Sterile Operations, governing and harmonizing aseptic processes across platforms and sites.
  • Provide proactive sterility assurance leadership during the design and qualification of new production facilities and microbiology laboratories, ensuring that layouts, processes, and controls meet all relevant regulatory, aseptic, and quality compliance requirements.
  • Serve as subject matter expert in microbiological topics, leading resolution of sterility and contamination escalations.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional and cross-site projects delivering U.S. sterility assurance priorities and global quality initiatives.
  • Monitor sterility assurance performance indicators and deliver clear, executive-level insights to enable timely, compliant decision-making.
  • Represent Novartis externally as a recognized sterility assurance expert, supporting U.S. industry engagement and global alignment.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, chemistry, microbiology, or a related scientific discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in global, cross-disciplinary project management and leadership roles within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably in strategic Site or global QA Operations and/or Compliance roles. Pharmaceutical production experience is indispensable.
  • Extensive experience delivering sterility assurance leadership within U.S. pharmaceutical manufacturing and FDA-regulated environments.
  • Deep technical expertise in microbiology, aseptic processing, and sterile manufacturing operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-level quality initiatives across multiple sites and manufacturing platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead cross-functional teams, and drive complex, high-impact programs.
  • Travel up to 25%
  • Language : French speaking and writing: Advanced. English speaking and writing: Advanced.

At Novartis Canada, we are determined to be a valued partner and advocate, with a deep understanding of patient needs along the entire care journey – from drug development, to diagnosis, to access and beyond. Part of the way we are doing this is by leveraging data, technology, and partnerships.

Research & Development: we focus on four core therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Renal & Metabolic, Immunology, Neuroscience and Oncology. We also develop and deliver treatments through other promoted and established brands, which today are helping millions of patients. Over the last three years, our average annual research and development investment in Canada was over $30 million, and we conduct clinical trial research in every region throughout Canada.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Novartis is committed to building outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse team’s representatives of the patients and communities we serve.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together?

The Motorola Solutions Demand Planning team plays a critical role in the global supply chain, ensuring that the company can meet the needs of its customers around the world. The team works to anticipate the needs of a wide range of customers, from first responders who depend on essential devices like two-way radios and the supporting network infrastructure, to enterprises that utilize video security products like body-worn cameras, video management software, and AI-powered analytics. This requires a deep understanding of market trends, product lifecycles, and regional sales forecasts to ensure that all products are available when and where they're needed. Demand planning is also highly cross-functional. The team collaborates with many different teams to create a unified demand signal that is a critical input to the company's Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle, which is used to align business functions and drive strategic decision-making.

The Supply Chain Data Analyst Intern will have the opportunity to manage a portion of a Demand Analyst portfolio, which offers real-time experience in demand planning activities. The intern will also be responsible for executing daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting to assist the planning organization as well as perform analyses and assist with projects cross-functionally within the broader supply chain organization. In addition, the SC Data Analyst Intern will be expected to complete a summer project that focuses on a specific deliverable with measurable benefit to the business. The summer program will conclude with a presentation of the summer project to MSI executives and senior leaders.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to develop, maintain, and improve the company’s internal business applications and system integrations.


This role will be responsible for end-to-end application development, covering frontend, backend, database management, deployment, system integration, and technical troubleshooting.


The Full Stack Developer will work closely with the Business Transformation team and business users to translate operational and business requirements into reliable, scalable, and maintainable digital solutions. The role will also support the company’s digital transformation initiatives, including ERP integration, process automation, and the adoption of relevant AI technologies.


Key Responsibilities


1. Full Stack Development


Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.


Develop backend services and business logic using Golang (Go).


Design, develop, and maintain REST APIs and system integration services.


Perform debugging, bug fixing, code optimization, and application maintenance.


Ensure applications are secure, scalable, maintainable, and reliable.


2. Database Management


Design, maintain, and optimize relational databases using SQL.


Develop database structures, queries, relationships, and data models.


Maintain data integrity and application performance.


Support database migration, backup, and recovery processes.


3. Git & Development Workflow


Use Git for source code management, including branching, pull/push, merging, and conflict resolution.


Manage Development, Staging, and Production environments.


Follow software development, version control, and release management best practices.


4. Deployment & Infrastructure


Deploy and maintain applications within company infrastructure, including Synology NAS/server environments.


Apply basic CI/CD and Docker/containerization practices.


Handle application configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, backup, and recovery.


Manage environment variables, networking, domains, SSL, API configuration, and basic server security.


5. ERP & System Integration


Develop and maintain integrations between internal applications and ERP/business systems such as Odoo, Accurate, or similar platforms.


Handle API integrations, authentication, data synchronization, data mapping, and error handling.


Work with business data including sales, purchasing, inventory, products, customers, finance, and operational data.


Collaborate with internal users and external vendors during system implementation and integration.


6. AI & Automation


Stay updated with developments in AI and modern software development technologies.


Utilize AI-assisted development tools to improve development productivity and code quality.


Explore and implement practical AI and automation use cases for internal business processes.


Evaluate new technologies based on business value, security, maintainability, and feasibility.


7. Technical Support & Documentation


Troubleshoot application, integration, database, and deployment issues.


Maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, API documentation, database structures, and deployment procedures.


Support testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-implementation activities.


Technical Requirements


Must Have


Strong proficiency in Next.js, React, and TypeScript.


Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases.


Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.


Experience developing and consuming REST APIs.


Understanding of authentication, authorization, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).


Experience with application deployment and production troubleshooting.


Strong understanding of end-to-end frontend, backend, and database architecture.


Preferred / Strong Advantage


Experience with Synology NAS/server environments, Docker, and CI/CD.


Experience integrating ERP or business systems such as Odoo, Accurate, or similar platforms.


Familiarity with cloud platforms and modern deployment environments.


Familiarity with AI coding tools, LLM APIs, workflow automation, or AI-enabled applications.


Experience developing internal systems, dashboards, ERP-related applications, or other business applications.


Qualifications


Education:Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields.


Experience:Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in Full Stack Development, Software Engineering, or related roles.


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.


Good communication and technical documentation skills.


Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with business and technical stakeholders.


Adaptable and willing to continuously learn new technologies.


Ideal Candidate Profile


We are looking for a developer who goes beyond executing predefined coding tasks and has a strong understanding of end-to-end systems and business processes.


The ideal candidate should be able to understand and analyze business requirements, propose appropriate technical solutions, develop the application, manage databases and integrations, deploy the solution, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve the system as business needs evolve.


Experience in internal business applications, ERP integrations, process automation, and digital transformation projects will be a strong advantage.

  • Demonstrated experience in staffing, team development, and retention.

title: Director, Finance
description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the General Secretary, the Director, Finance is responsible for providing strategic leadership and oversight of the Association's Finance Department, encompassing the General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Procurement & Compliance functions. The role ensures the integrity of financial reporting, sound financial governance, effective procurement practices, regulatory compliance and prudent stewardship of the Association's financial resources. The Finance Director partners with Management and EXCO to support strategic decision making, organisational sustainability and operational excellence.

Job Description

Financial Leadership

  • Lead and manage the Finance Department, ensuring effective delivery across General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Procurement & Compliance functions
  • Develop and execute the Finance Department's strategy, objectives and annual work plans
  • Provide financial advice and recommendations to the General Secretary, Management and EXC

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing process
  • Review and approve management accounts, financial statements, grant reporting and EXCO reports
  • Ensure compliance with SFRS, statutory requirements and organisational accounting policies
  • Oversee cash flow, treasury and working capital management

Budgeting & Financial Planning

  • Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process
  • Monitor organisational financial performance through budget versus actual analysis
  • Provide financial insights to support strategic planning and resource allocation

Procurement & Compliance

  • Provide strategic oversight of procurement and contract governance
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, grant funding requirements and delegated approval authorities
  • Review and endorse high-value procurement submissions and EXCO papers

Governance, Audit & Risk

  • Lead internal and external audit engagements and ensure timely resolution of audit findings
  • Strengthen financial governance, internal controls and enterprise risk management within the Finance function
  • Ensure compliance with Sport Singapore, FIFA, AFC, IPC and other applicable regulatory and grant requirements

Leadership & People Management

  • Lead, coach and develop Finance Managers and team members to build a highperforming finance function
  • Establish departmental KPIs and monitor team performance
  • Drive succession planning, capability development and a culture of continuous improvement

Systems & Transformation

  • Champion finance digitalisation, ERP optimisation and process automation initiatives
  • Lead finance transformation projects to improve efficiency, reporting quality and internal controls

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary finance representative to auditors, banks, government agencies, funding bodies and key external stakeholders
  • Partner with internal departments to provide strategic financial guidance and support organisational objectives

Other Duties

  • Must be willing to work on match days, including weekends, in line with SPL, WPL, and National Team calendar
  • Undertake any other duties assigned by the General Secretary or EXCO

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. Professional qualification (CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent) preferred
  • Minimum 12 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, with proven experience in financial reporting, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, procurement governance and team leadership
  • Strong knowledge of Singapore Financial Reporting Standards (SFRS), financial reporting, budgeting, internal controls and corporate governance
  • Experience leading annual audits, statutory reporting, cash flow management and finance transformation initiatives
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management and people development skills
  • Experience in the public sector, sports industry, non-profit or grant-funded environment will be an advantage

title: Product Specialist
description:
Beamtree is a proudly Australian, publicly listed company committed to delivering enhanced value to healthcare systems both locally and globally.

Our comprehensive suite of health information management solutions – including PICQ, PICQ Audit, RISQ, the Integrated Coding Platform (ICP), and Autonomous Coding – is designed to improve the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of clinical coded data. These tools also provide powerful platforms for analytics that support informed clinical and operational decision-making.

We are continuously evolving our product suite and are actively developing a fully integrated, end-to-end coding solution. This innovation spans the entire health information management lifecycle – from documentation improvement and code finding to auditing, autonomous coding, and real-time analytics – enabling smarter, data-driven workflows that help health systems achieve better patient outcomes and secure appropriate funding.

We are seeking a Product Specialist to join our growing team of HIMs, clinical coders, product innovators, and data technology specialists. This role plays a pivotal part in shaping Beamtree’s end-to-end coding platform, acting as a subject matter expert, feature lead, client facing advisor, and product champion.

If you’re passionate about clinical coding, health information management, product innovation, and client engagement, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

This is a remote role, with some travel required to client offices around Australia and our head office in Sydney.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide subject matter expertise across Beamtree’s coding products
  • Product Feature Lead for core enhancements, defining the scope, workflows, user experience, and content, and acting as the primary champion for the feature throughout its lifecycle
  • Support roadmap decisions by capturing, synthesising, communicating client feedback and market trends
  • Drive product implementation, optimisation, training and ongoing support
  • Support clients with product related queries to ensure maximum use from their coding solutions
  • Deliver engaging product demonstrations, discovery workshops and presentations
  • Build and harness strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor to coding managers, HIMs and clinicians.
  • Attend Industry events, showcasing Beamtree’s Coding Products, deliver workshops and support with client presentations
  • Conduct ICD-10-AM coding audits and quality reviews
  • Create user guides, training materials, and release documentation
  • Stay up to date with IHACPA guidelines and coding standards
  • Development and curation of autonomous coding rules and classification logic, coding indicators and quality metrics

What You’ll Bring

  • Must have a Masters or Bachelor in Health Information Management or Clinical Coding qualifications
  • Must have current clinical coding ICD-10-AM 13th edition experience, preferably audit experience with ICD-10-AM 13th Edition.
  • Eligible for HIMAA full membership
  • 5–10 years’ experience in HIM/clinical coding
  • Auditing qualifications (La Trobe University or equivalent highly desirable)
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-AM and Activity Based Funding
  • Excellent communication and public speaking skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently
  • Willingness to travel within Australia (optional overseas travel)

Why Join Beamtree?

  • Work with a passionate team driving innovation in healthcare
  • 5 weeks annual leave, paid parental leave and blood donor leave
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements
  • Opportunities for professional development and travel
  • Be part of a values-driven culture focused on impact and collaboration

Ready to make a difference in healthcare? Apply now and help us shape the future of clinical data quality.

title: Service Professional (Annuities)
description:
Job Description:

Job Description

The Service Professional plays a vital role in delivering Top-Tier Service to our clients, ensuring each interaction reflects Penn Mutual’s unwavering commitment to excellence. Our team members take ownership of building meaningful relationships with every caller and embrace the accountability that comes with being a trusted voice of Penn Mutual to our policyholders, beneficiaries, and Financial Professionals.

Those selected for this role will demonstrate a passion for best-in-class service, managing a variety of inbound calls with care and professionalism. Responsibilities include actively listening to callers’ needs, resolving inquiries promptly and accurately, educating on policy details, and proactively identifying solutions that support both immediate and long-term goals. Every interaction should foster a seamless, thoughtful, and trusted customer experience.

We have embraced a flexible approach to work as we are 100% remote. This model allows you to balance your life and bring your whole self to work so that you can focus on providing top-tier service to our financial professionals and the account holders.

Responsibilities.

  • Compassionate problem solver for our clients and policy beneficiaries.

  • Empathetically listen to clients’ concerns, provide emotional support during challenging situations, and offer solutions that meet their current and future needs.

  • Serve as a dedicated advocate for policyholders, understanding their unique needs and advocating on their behalf within the organization to ensure their concerns are addressed promptly and efficiently.

  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous improvement by actively seeking feedback, participating in training programs, and implementing best practices in Customer Success.

  • Develop in-depth knowledge of Penn Mutual’s life and annuity products.

  • Manage a wide range of inbound client inquiries with professionalism and accuracy.

  • Investigate and follow up on basic or routine questions/issues to resolve concerns in an accurate and timely manner.

  • Accept ownership of the interaction and provide a high caliber of service and follow-through.

  • Interpret each request and navigate multiple administration systems as well as our workflow and imaging tools to gain and document needed information.

  • Process routine financial and non-financial transactions and document records with consistent quality, attention to detail, and according to department policies and procedures.

  • Recommend and facilitate process changes to continuously improve customer experience.

  • Meet or exceed individual and team performance goals and service metrics.

  • Escalate more complex issues as appropriate.

  • Responsible for adherence to the company’s framework of internal controls.

  • Work collaboratively and may participateon project teams as needed.

  • Ability to work a shift currently between the hours of 8am ET and 6pm ET, Monday through Friday.

  • Complies with all company and site policies and procedures.

  • Remains current in profession and industry trends.

  • Successfully completes regulatory and job training requirements.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities

  • Execute requests with urgency, thoroughness, and professionalism.

  • Ability to navigate multiple systems and resources.

  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, required.

  • Willingness and proven ability to work on multiple tasks and adapt to a changing work environment.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills – the ability to see beyond the request by the caller to determine what may be intended.

  • Willingness and ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to make a positive contribution as demonstrated by learning new skills and making suggestions for process/procedure improvement.

  • Ability to work with others in a collaborative team environment.

description:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

Computer Vision Intern

About the Role

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between theoretical computer vision and real-world industrial applications? Zebra Technologies is looking for a driven Computer Vision & AI Intern to join our Advanced Data Capture team for a 3-month part-time internship.

In this role, you will work closely with our expert team of Algorithm Researchers and Software Engineers to develop, optimize, and test next-generation algorithms for 2D barcode detection and decoding. You will gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of industrial image processing—from classical computer vision techniques to cutting-edge deep learning models—all while writing robust implementation code in Python and C/C++.

Key Responsibilities

  • Algorithm Development: Assist in researching, designing, and testing algorithms for robust barcode detection and decoding in challenging conditions (e.g., blur, low illumination, complex backgrounds).
  • Hybrid Approaches: Work on both Classical Computer Vision (feature extraction, grid building, signal analysis) and Deep Learning-based methods for image classification and localization.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Contribute to the end-to-end 2D barcode decoding pipeline, writing efficient and maintainable implementation code in Python and C/C++.
  • Data Experimentation: Help evaluate model performance and potentially assist with synthetic data generation pipelines to improve algorithm robustness against realistic degradations (like ink spread or curvature).
  • Collaboration: Participate in technical reviews and collaborate directly with senior algorithm researchers and software engineers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a highly related field.
  • Strong theoretical understanding of image processing and Computer Vision fundamentals.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and C/C++.
  • Familiarity with at least one major deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to dedicate 20 hours per week for the 3-month duration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior academic or project experience related to Direct Part Marking (DPM) or barcode scanning technologies.
  • Understanding of optimization techniques for deploying CV algorithms in C/C++.
  • A strong portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing relevant computer vision projects.

title: Remote Diagnostic Technician
description:
Work Smarter. Diagnose Anywhere. Leave the Toolbox Behind.

Are you an experienced Automotive Technician, Diagnostic Specialist or Auto Electrician who loves solving the problems others can't and you're ready to take your expertise beyond the workshop floor?

SMART AVR is looking for an experienced Remote Diagnostic Technician to join our growing technical team.

This is an opportunity to use the knowledge you've built throughout your automotive career in a specialist, office-based role, providing remote diagnostic and technical support to technicians across Australia.

You'll work across a broad range of makes, models and technologies, using OEM diagnostic platforms, technical information and your own experience to help solve complex faults, guide repair decisions and support technicians when they need expert assistance.

You'll stay connected to the technical side of the automotive industry without spending every day on the tools.

Why Join SMART AVR?

  • Step off the workshop floor while continuing to use and develop your technical expertise
  • Work with OEM diagnostic software, manufacturer platforms and advanced vehicle technology
  • Gain exposure to a broad range of vehicle makes, models and complex technical issues
  • Expand your knowledge across diagnostics, vehicle electronics, programming and ADAS
  • Access ongoing training and professional development
  • Become part of a national automotive technical support team
  • Be the trusted expert technicians turn to when they need help solving difficult problems
  • Work in an environment where your technical knowledge and problem-solving ability are valued
  • Flexible working arrangements can be discussed as part of the recruitment process

About the Role

As a Remote Diagnostic Technician, you'll provide technical guidance and diagnostic support to technicians across our national network.

Using OEM diagnostic software, wiring diagrams, repair information, technical service bulletins and manufacturer resources, you'll help technicians identify faults, determine the right diagnostic pathway and reach accurate repair solutions.

Some enquiries may be resolved quickly. Others will require you to dig deeper, interpreting fault codes, reviewing electrical systems and communication networks, researching manufacturer information and working methodically with the technician to get to the root cause.

You'll become an important part of SMART AVR's technical support capability, helping our frontline teams diagnose vehicles efficiently, reduce unnecessary parts replacement and deliver the right repair outcome.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide remote diagnostic and technical support via phone, video, remote desktop platforms and written communication
  • Diagnose and research complex vehicle faults across multiple makes and models
  • Interpret fault codes, electrical issues, network communication faults and vehicle system failures
  • Utilise OEM diagnostic software, wiring diagrams, repair manuals, manufacturer portals and technical service bulletins
  • Guide technicians through logical diagnostic processes and repair procedures
  • Support the installation, configuration and troubleshooting of diagnostic software and equipment
  • Assist with ADAS diagnostics, programming and calibration enquiries
  • Research unfamiliar or emerging technical issues and identify practical solutions
  • Stay current with evolving vehicle technologies, electronic systems and manufacturer updates
  • Manage multiple technical support requests while maintaining a high standard of service
  • Share technical knowledge and contribute to internal resources, procedures and best-practice documentation
  • Help build the diagnostic capability and confidence of technicians across our network

About You

You're the person other technicians come to when a fault doesn't make sense.

You enjoy the challenge of working through difficult diagnostic problems, understanding why something has failed rather than simply replacing parts until the problem disappears.

You've built strong technical knowledge through years of hands-on experience, but you're also comfortable admitting when you don't immediately know the answer. More importantly, you know how to find it. You're confident researching technical information, navigating manufacturer systems, interpreting wiring diagrams and using diagnostic data to work logically towards a solution.

Technology doesn't intimidate you. You're comfortable moving between scan tools, OEM platforms, technical databases, remote support software and different vehicle systems and you're genuinely interested in where automotive technology is heading.

Just as importantly, you can communicate.

You understand that being technically knowledgeable is only part of the role. You'll be supporting technicians with different levels of experience, so you need the patience and communication skills to ask the right questions, explain complex information clearly and guide someone through a diagnostic process remotely.

You'll be someone who:

  • Naturally approaches problems in a logical and methodical way
  • Enjoys tackling the difficult faults that require deeper investigation
  • Can separate symptoms from root causes and avoid assumptions
  • Is confident making technical decisions based on evidence and diagnostic data
  • Communicates clearly and professionally with technicians and other stakeholders
  • Enjoys sharing knowledge and helping other technicians improve
  • Is comfortable working independently while contributing to a collaborative technical team
  • Can prioritise multiple enquiries without losing attention to detail
  • Takes ownership of problems and follows them through to a practical resolution
  • Is curious about new vehicle technology and committed to continually developing their knowledge
  • Wants to build a long-term career in automotive diagnostics and technical support

Ultimately, we're looking for someone with strong technical capability, curiosity and the right mindset. You don't need to know everything but you need to be someone who won't stop at the first answer when a problem requires deeper investigation.

Essential Experience

  • Trade qualification as an Automotive Technician, Diagnostic Technician or Auto Electrician
  • Minimum 5 years' post-trade experience
  • Strong experience diagnosing faults across multiple vehicle makes and models
  • Sound understanding of vehicle electronics, control modules, communication networks and fault-code interpretation
  • Experience using OEM diagnostic tooling and software
  • Confidence navigating manufacturer portals and technical information systems
  • Strong computer and general technology skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to explain complex technical information clearly and practically
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Self-motivated approach with a genuine interest in continuous learning and emerging automotive technology

Highly Regarded

Experience in any of the following would be highly regarded:

  • Automotive technical support, helpdesk, field support or technical advisory roles
  • Advanced diagnostic training or specialist diagnostic certifications
  • Auto Electrical qualifications
  • ADAS diagnostics and calibration
  • Remote diagnostic or technical support platforms
  • Mentoring, coaching or training technicians
  • Advanced electrical and network diagnostics

What's It Like Working Here?

This isn't your typical workshop role.

Instead of working on the same vehicles or repairs every day, you'll be exposed to technical challenges from across a national network.

One enquiry might involve an electrical fault that has already defeated several technicians. The next could involve an OEM programming issue, an ADAS system, a communication network fault or a vehicle technology you've never encountered before.

That's what makes the role interesting.

You'll work alongside experienced automotive and diagnostic professionals, share knowledge across the team and continue building your expertise as vehicle technology evolves.

It's an opportunity to take everything you've learned on the tools and apply it in a different way solving problems, supporting technicians and becoming a trusted technical resource across the business.

If you're passionate about diagnostics, enjoy helping others and like being the person people turn to when they need an answer, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply Now

Ready to take the next step in your automotive career?

If you want to move beyond the workshop floor without walking away from the technical side of the industry, SMART AVR offers the opportunity to turn your experience into a specialist career in automotive diagnostics and technical support.

Join SMART AVR and put your technical expertise to work across Australia's repair network.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Tellent, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we build, run, and scale our platform. Tellent brings together Recruitee and TellentHR to help organizations attract, hire, and grow great teams.

You’ll work hands-on across our cloud infrastructure, collaborating closely with engineering teams — bringing an automation, observability, and security-aware mindset to everything we do.

About the team

You’ll join a small, experienced DevOps team responsible for keeping our platform stable, efficient, and developer-friendly.

We operate with high autonomy and embrace the “you build it, you run it” culture — empowering teams through automation, monitoring, and clear ownership.

We think that security, reliability, performance and transparency are shared responsibilities: we continuously improve our detection, response, and audit readiness together with engineering.

We work remotely first, but hybrid or office-based collaboration is possible. Our work hours are flexible with a core block reserved for synchronisation — 10 am–4 pm.

Because we're remote-first, we rely heavily on asynchronous communication. We share context openly — explaining our reasoning, updating progress, and managing expectations of the teams we support. This makes our work visible, builds trust, and ensures continuity — especially critical during on-call handoffs.

Your journey

First 3 Months: Learn our GCP, AWS and Kubernetes environments, Terraform structure, and GitHub Actions pipelines. Follow our onboarding process and provide feedback to it. You will get your first simple tasks, providing the real value in 2 weeks. Receive support and navigation from other DevOps team members. Meet the team & important stakeholders.

After those 3 months you will join the on-call rotation, to understand our production systems even deeper.

And last but not least — every now and then we close the laptops, meet in person, and share good food and stories.

Within 6 Months: You independently lead projects — scoping work, breaking it into deliverables, and communicating progress to the team. Focus areas include infrastructure automation, observability, and reliability improvements. You contribute to incident troubleshooting.

Enhance workload security by integrating AIkido findings, strengthening detection, and hardening configurations.

Take part in security audits and conduct post-mortem reviews, helping identify and close gaps.

After 1 Year: Be a key voice shaping Tellent’s platform direction — ensuring bulletproof monitoring, secure and self-healing systems, and scalable, well-documented infrastructure.

Influence microservice design and platform standards across teams, embedding security and reliability from the start.

What you'll be doing

  • Own and drive infrastructure projects end-to-end — from breaking down the problem into subtasks, through implementation, to communicating results to stakeholders. We don't just "do tasks"; we solve problems and explain how and why.

  • Evolve Kubernetes (with Argo) and cloud infrastructure — mostly GCP. Take part in cloud infrastructure unification.

  • Develop and maintain Terraform configurations for scalable, reliable systems.

  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

  • Strengthen observability with OpenTelemetry and Datadog.

  • Integrate and act on insights from AIkido and other security tools to detect and mitigate issues within workloads.

  • Support and tune PostgreSQL and other managed databases used by our applications.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams — proactively communicate progress, share context, and manage expectations. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues as part of our on-call rotation.

  • Participate in internal and external security audits, ensuring our systems meet compliance and resilience standards.

  • Drive SRE and GitOps principles — from post-mortems to automation and clear documentation.

What you bring

  • Solid experience operating in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus).

  • You know your way around managing RDBMSs (we use Postgres)

  • Comfort working in Ubuntu/Linux-based systems.

  • AI as a daily tool — you actively use AI assistants and automation to move faster, solve problems, and reduce toil. You understand their strengths and limitations, and you're always looking for new ways to leverage them.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a calm, collaborative approach to resolving production incidents.

  • Self-management skills — you can break down ambiguous problems into concrete steps, prioritize your work, and drive projects forward without constant direction.

  • Excellent async communication — you proactively share your thinking process, progress, and decisions in writing. You manage stakeholder expectations, make your work visible, and ensure others can pick up where you left off. In a remote team, written communication is how we build trust, share knowledge, and maintain continuity.

  • Can-do attitude, curiosity, and craftsmanship spirit.

  • Fluent Polish and intermediate or higher English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).

  • Familiarity with cloud workload security tools (e.g., Aikido, GCP Security Command Center) and vulnerability management.

  • Background in distributed systems or large-scale architecture.

  • Previous experience as a backend developer (Elixir, , or similar).

What We Offer

  • Primarily remote working with flexibility and opportunities to connect with the team

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • Annual compensation range: 22000-28000 PLN/month (+ VAT where applicable)

  • Time off for employment contract (UoP): 26 paid holiday days + 2 wellbeing days

  • €1500 annual learning budget

  • Wellness perks including Multisport and private healthcare (LuxMed)

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook, displays, and all the tools you need to succeed

  • €200 home office budget + work-from-home allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our , check our , or chat with us at .

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

As a Sr. Distinguished Engineer at Capital One, you will be a part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of payments in the cloud.

You will work alongside a talented team of developers, machine learning experts, product managers, and people leaders using modern AI tools to deliver technical solutions to complex problems. The Global Payment Network (GPN) Technology organization designs, builds, and operates the mission-critical systems and infrastructure that seamlessly power complex money movement across domestic and international rails. We build and operate a high-volume, low-latency, and highly resilient distributed ecosystem that is simultaneously secure, performant, accurate, and nimble.

As an engineer in the Global Payment Network, you will apply your technical acumen to shape and deliver solutions to complex problems at massive scale. title: Commodities Document Negotiator - Fixed Income Division - Associate or Vice Pres
description:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

Department Profile:
The Fixed Income Division (“FID”) sits within the Institutional Securities Group (“ISG”) and is comprised of Interest Rate and Currency Products, Credit Products, Commodities, Repo, and TBAs and Distribution. Professionals in FID assess and actively manage risk, trade securities, and structure as well as execute innovative transactions in the fast-paced and constantly changing global markets.

From the largest global institutions to innovative new hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument including stocks, bonds, derivatives, foreign exchange, and commodities. Our professionals provide liquidity and content to clients around the world, actively assessing and managing risk, trading securities, and planning and executing transactions in the fast-changing markets. As the needs of our clients become increasingly complex, we often develop customized solutions.

Team Profile:
The Institutional Securities Documentation team sits within FID’s Business Control Unit (“BCU”) and is a first line team comprised of Non-Market Risk (Operational Risk), Counterparty Risk, Conduct Risk and Contract Negotiations. The Institutional Securities Documentation Team covers the contract negotiation function for trading agreements for FID.

We are looking for an individual in the documentation unit supporting the Commodities desks with negotiations of physical and financial master agreements and ancillary documents. As a member of the documentation unit, the team member will review and negotiate ISDA schedules, various ISDA annexes, NAESBs, EEIs, credit support annexes, bespoke physical master agreements, guaranties and ancillary documents. The candidate will work closely with business professionals across the firm, as well as with external counsel and clients. The primary objective will be to execute master agreements in an effective and efficient manor.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

Responsibilities include:

  • The timely, consistent and effective negotiation, review, and drafting of master agreements (using both English and New York law) upon request from the Business Unit to help facilitate their business.
  • Liaise with Credit, Risk, Legal, Sales, Operations, Tax and other internal groups to ensure that the appropriate terms are included in all agreements for the effective protection of Morgan Stanley in line with applicable policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Converse with clients regarding Morgan Stanley’s position in master agreements
  • Keeping work in progress records up to date.
  • Keeping informed of business and regulatory developments as they impact on the way in which the business operates

Qualifications:

  • JD preferred
  • Experience in reviewing, drafting and negotiating the ISDA Master Agreement and other trading documentation preferred
  • College degree required
  • Must have excellent verbal and written skills
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to clearly articulate ideas and forge strong relationships internally and with external clients
  • Highly motivated and adaptable; the ability to work on a team of diverse individuals
  • Must be mature and professional
  • Must be proactive and have the ability to work independently and to perform consistently and respond creatively in a high volume fast paced and changing environment
  • Accurate and detail-oriented with sound judgment and integrity

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste into your browser.

However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

QA


Job Description

We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Salesforce QA Engineer with 4–5 years of dedicated software testing experience to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be ensuring the quality, reliability, and seamless user experience of our Salesforce platform, focusing heavily on Sales Cloud.


Basic Requirements

Key Responsibilities

A) Functional & End-to-End Salesforce Testing

  • Analyze complex business requirements and user stories to design, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, manual test cases, and precise UAT (User Acceptance Testing) scripts.
  • Perform rigorous functional, regression, smoke, and ad-hoc testing specifically tailored for Salesforce Sales Cloud (including Lead conversion, Opportunity pipelines, Account/Contact management, Quotes, and Forecasting).
  • Validate complex Salesforce configurations, such as custom lightning components, validation rules, Flow automations, approval processes, and security models (profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules).
  • Conduct integration testing to ensure seamless data flow between Salesforce and external, third-party systems.
  • Support and guide the business users with executing the test scripts as part of the user acceptance testing

B) Backend Data Validation & Querying

  • Write and execute SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language) queries via Developer Console or Workbench to perform backend data validation.
  • Verify data integrity, check field mappings, and validate complex data migrations or bulk updates directly at the database layer.
  • Monitor debug logs and asynchronous operations (like batch jobs) to track down root causes of failures.

C) Collaboration & Defect Management

  • Log, track, and manage bugs rigorously using tools like Jira or Azure DevOps, providing clear replication steps and logs to development teams.
  • Collaborate closely with Salesforce Developers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners to ensure alignment on business logic and release timelines.

D) AI tools

  • Knowledge of AI tools ( ex - Copilot) and leveraging them to optimize traditional testing workflows.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4–5 years of core QA experience, with at least 3 years focused heavily on manual testing within the Salesforce ecosystem.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • Salesforce Expertise: Strong functional knowledge of Sales Cloud configurations, standard objects, and common sales workflows.

  • Data Validation: Strong hands-on experience using SOQL queries for backend testing and data validation.

  • Process: Mastery of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the standard Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).

  • Skills: Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Ability to build strong relationships with business stakeholders.

  • Experience working in an agile development environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Good to Have Skills

  • Automation Exposure: Foundational knowledge or hands-on experience writing basic test scripts using Playwright with JavaScript (especially useful for identifying elements in Salesforce's shadow DOM).

  • Hands-on experience testing Agentforce use cases

  • Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator or Salesforce Certified Service/Sales Cloud Consultant.

title: M54 - Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

  • We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, secure, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade digital products on Microsoft Azure.
  • This is an AI-enabled engineering role where you will leverage modern AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent to enhance coding productivity, technical problem-solving, test generation, documentation, and overall delivery quality.
  • As part of the Platform & Software Engineering Division, you will contribute to JTC’s Digital Factory Platform, developing cloud-native applications, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-enabled solutions that can move efficiently from concept to production.
  • You will work across the full application stack, including React/TypeScript frontend development, Java and Python backend services, APIs, databases, Azure cloud services, DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade full stack applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, Python, FastAPI, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations following modern engineering practices.
  • Develop cloud-native solutions using Microsoft Azure services such as:
  1. Azure App Service and Azure Functions
  2. Azure API Management
  3. Azure SQL Database and Azure Storage
  4. Azure Service Bus and Event Grid
  5. Azure Key Vault
  6. Azure Monitor and Application Insights
  7. Microsoft Entra ID
  • Design and implement data solutions using SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimisation, ORM frameworks, and secure data handling.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Apply DevSecOps and secure software development practices, including secrets management, vulnerability scanning, automated testing, secure coding, and compliance checks.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent tools.
  • Containerise and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes/AKS where appropriate.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot services, or equivalent platforms where relevant.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT for coding, refactoring, test generation, documentation, and technical problem-solving while maintaining appropriate human review and security controls.
  • Participate in technical design, architecture reviews, and integration planning to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable.
  • Support production environments through troubleshooting, performance optimisation, monitoring, alerting, observability, and incident resolution.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business users, platform engineers, security teams, and other stakeholders within Agile delivery teams.
  • Maintain technical documentation, engineering decisions, reusable patterns, and operational procedures.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on software development experience, including ownership of enterprise application design, delivery, deployment, and production support.
  • Strong full stack development experience with modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript; exposure to Angular or Vue.js is advantageous.
  • Strong backend development experience using Java and/or Python, with frameworks such as:
  1. Spring Boot
  2. FastAPI
  3. Flask
  4. Django
  5. Or equivalent frameworks
  • Strong experience developing REST APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on Microsoft Azure experience within a production environment.
  • Experience with Azure PaaS and cloud-native services, particularly App Service, Azure Functions, API Management, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, and Key Vault.
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorisation using Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity, and RBAC.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD using Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, using Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent.
  • Experience with Docker, containerised applications, Kubernetes, and/or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Good understanding of secure application development, including secrets management, security scanning, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, performance optimisation, and production support capabilities.
  • Experience working within Agile product delivery teams and collaborating across engineering, business, product, security, and operations functions.
  • Ability to translate business and product requirements into practical technical designs, architecture options, and implementation plans.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working within Singapore Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) or other regulated enterprise environments.
  • Experience integrating AI capabilities using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or Copilot services.
  • Experience with platform engineering, internal developer platforms, developer portals, or reusable engineering templates.
  • Experience implementing cloud security controls including RBAC, Managed Identity, secrets management, network controls, and secure service-to-service communication.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, or equivalent messaging technologies.
  • Familiarity with domain-driven design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logs, dashboards, traces, and application health metrics.
  • Familiarity with engineering and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and Azure DevOps.

Key Competencies

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with a focus on clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
  • Ability to work confidently across the full technology stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production environments.
  • Strong cloud-first and cloud-native mindset, particularly within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • Strong ownership and accountability from solution design through development, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to business, product, security, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to balance delivery speed, security, scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Willingness to continuously learn and adopt modern engineering and AI-enabled development practices.
  • Ability to use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity and quality without compromising security, maintainability, or engineering accountability.
