title: Network Field Technician
description:
Syringa Networks combines the stability of a traditional ISP with the agility and innovation of a Modern Partner. Headquartered in Boise, Idaho, Syringa operates more than 2,000 miles of fiber network throughout the Mountain West and Pacific Northwest regions. Syringa has expanded its reach globally to deliver Internet Connectivity, IP Transport, and IT Solutions anywhere businesses need them. These capabilities paired with our world-class customer experience, allow Syringa to be a strategic partner to organizations to simplify and optimize their business operations.


Our Network Field Technicians play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient functioning of telecommunications networks by installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting network equipment, providing technical support, and ensuring compliance with industry standards. Network Field Technicians in telecommunications are responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting telecommunications equipment and networks. Level of position and pay is dependent on experience.


Must reside in the Eastern Idaho area with a primary reporting location of Idaho Falls. Work and customer demands will dicate the opportunity to work remotely at times. Must have the ability to securely park a company vehicle and store company-issued tools and equipment at primary residence.


Essential Job Functions:

  • You have technical experience and a good understanding of telecom networks working as a field technician demonstrated by your ability to handle more complex tasks, including network installations, upgrades, and repairs, as well as assisting in troubleshooting advanced issues.
  • Must be able to work independently or with others while applying appropriate methods to troubleshoot issues with the help of remote employees in our NOC or other groups.
  • Responsible for assisting senior technicians, provisioners, NOC, and engineers in installing, troubleshooting, and maintaining telecommunications networks. Their roles and responsibilities may include:
  • Assisting in the installation and configuration of network hardware, including routers, switches, and wireless access points.
  • Assisting in the installation and termination of network cables and connectors.
  • Performing routine network monitoring tasks to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Troubleshooting network connectivity issues and resolving them within designated SLAs.
  • Assisting in the diagnosis and resolution of network performance issues.
  • Assisting in the maintenance and documentation of network infrastructure.
  • Providing on-site support to customers for network-related problems.
  • Assisting in the implementation of network security measures.
  • Collaborating with team members to ensure efficient and effective network operations.
  • Basic understanding of power – DC vs. AC, Amps vs. Volts
  • Understanding how to use test equipment including T-Bird, Exfo platform, - 10G, 100G, Viavi- PRI Ethernet tester, Multimeter, and OTDR’s.
  • Good understanding of our services and delivery methods Eth, TDM, SONET, DWDM, IP, SD-WAN
  • A good technical and mechanical background with experience in the latest generation transport gear, critical infrastructure (HVAC systems, high-voltage electrical systems, DC power plants, etc.), as well as knowledge of locating fiber optic cable, right-of-way, and As-Builts.
  • Skilled in technical communications with customers and vendors, to help resolve issues.
  • Inventory management is critical in all technician job roles.
  • Maintain warehouse and inventory counts of equipment and equipment spares.
  • Handles and maintains the flow of materials and products for installations and trouble tickets.
  • Unpacks and checks goods received against purchase orders or invoices.
  • Maintains accurate records of received goods and rejects unsatisfactory items.
  • Facilities Maintenance
  • Schedule and manage vendors who work on our various critical infrastructure equipment, such as HVAC systems, UPS, and generators
  • Perform building maintenance activities, such as routine facilities tasks and inspections, and work with other Syringa employees on requests that might come in, including office moves.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

As the IT Subscriptions Product Owner, you will be a pivotal leader, driving the strategy and future direction of our subscription ecosystem through industry thought leadership. You will be instrumental in defining the product vision, prioritizing features, and ensuring our subscription platform delivers significant value to our customers and stakeholders. Beyond traditional product ownership, this role demands you act as a strategic partner and innovator, challenging the status quo and identifying new opportunities in the recurring revenue landscape.

You will act as the voice of the customer and key stakeholder for one or more Agile development teams, focusing on maximizing the value of the product. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of business acumen in recurring revenue models and technical knowledge of IT systems for billing, provisioning, and customer lifecycle management, combined with a proven ability to influence business strategy.


Basic Requirements

Required Skills

  • Product & Business: Strategic Thought Leadership, Subscription Lifecycle Management, Recurring Revenue Models, Product Roadmap development, Value-driven prioritization, Customer-centricity.

  • Technical: Agile/Scrum/Kanban proficiency, Experience with Subscription Management/Billing Platforms (e.g. Oracle Subscription Cloud, Zuora etc). Ability to understand process flows, system integration, and data flows.

  • Core Competencies: Exceptional Communication (written and verbal) , Strategic Influence & Stakeholder Management , Analytical and Problem-Solving skills , Decisive Decision-Making , Leadership without authority.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in an Agile environment. Specific experience working on B2B or B2C subscription products, billing systems, or e-commerce platforms is highly desirable.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Tools: Proficiency with collaboration and backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Trello).


Travel Requirements

None


Relocation Provided

None

Experienced

Yes

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
description:
Tech en teamwork in het hart van Nederland In Woerden werk je met oa.

Zorg ervoor dat al uw sollicitatiegegevens up-to-date en in orde zijn voordat u op deze vacature solliciteert.

Snowflake, DBT en Python aan slimme data oplossingen.

Samen met ilionx regio Midden bouw je aan resultaat dat telt! jouw functie als Azure Data Engineer Ben jij gek op data én techniek? Dan zit je bij ons in Woerden helemaal goed! Als Data Engineer werk je aan slimme en schaalbare data oplossingen in de cloud.

Je gebruikt tools als Python, PySpark, DBT en SQL en werkt met platformen als Snowflake, Databricks en Microsoft Fabric.

Of het nu gaat om het ontsluiten van databronnen, bouwen van data pipelines of het neerzetten van een compleet dataplatform: jij zorgt dat het staat als een huis.

Wat deze vestiging uniek maakt? We hebben hier een sterke achtergrond in managed analytics , afkomstig uit onze Inergy tijd.

Veel van onze klanten vertrouwen dagelijks op de oplossingen die wij bouwen en beheren.

Denk aan projecten binnen de overheid, energie, retail en finance, waarbij je écht impact maakt met data.

Daarnaast krijg je bij ons de ruimte om te experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën, zoals generatieve AI.

Je werkt in een dynamische regio: ilionx Woerden is onderdeel van regio Midden, en werkt intensief samen met de collega’s uit onze vestigingen in Amsterdam, Utrecht en Den Bosch.

Dat betekent veel kennisuitwisseling, gezamenlijke projecten en de mogelijkheid om regiobreed mee te denken over proposities en technische richting.

Je kunt aan de slag op klantlocatie of vanuit ons kantoor in Woerden, net wat past bij jou en het project.

Je kiest opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw interesses, of dat nu het bouwen van een Snowflake platform is, meedraaien in teamopdrachten of bijdragen aan interne proposities zoals ZorgControl of het ilionx Dataplatform.

En wil je doorgroeien? Dan zijn er volop routes.

Of je nu verder wilt als technische specialist, architect, trainer of richting AI en data science: bij ons kies je zelf je pad.

Wij zorgen dat je daarin wordt ondersteund! wat bieden wij jou: Een salarisrange tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- op 40 uur met bonus! Een uitgebreide leaseregeling voor zowel auto als fiets Een gevarieerd werkveld: extern, intern of een mix Een flexibele werkomgeving en wij omarmen het hybride werken Een flinke focus op de AI transitie, daar zijn wij volop mee bezig wat vragen wij van jou: Een afgeronde HBO/WO diploma Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring met BI en/of Data Engineering Kennis van en ervaring met Data Engineering binnen Azure omgevingen Kennis van en ervaring met: Python en Spark Kennis van: Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake, Synapse Kennis van dimensionaal datamodelleren en logical modelling Kennis van de data architecture concepten Medallion en Mesh Je ziet de kansen van AI en denkt vooruit Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vloeiend in woord en geschrift Deze eisen geven een richting aan het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie.

Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren! het team In Woerden werk je in een enthousiast team met een berg aan ervaring én energie.

We combineren technische diepgang met een informele sfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt.

Onze roots liggen bij Inergy, dus de focus op Snowflake en datagedreven werken zit diep in ons DNA.

We houden van korte lijntjes, kennis delen en elkaar beter maken.

Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen en jezelf te ontwikkelen, zonder gedoe of bureaucratie.

Tegelijk doen we het echt samen.

Successen vieren we met z’n allen, en buiten werktijd zoeken we elkaar op voor een borrel, uitje (zoals de befaamde wintersport) of spontane tafelvoetbalsessie.

Klaar voor een plek waar je inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd én plezier hebt in wat je doet? Dan ben je in Woerden aan het juiste adres! landelijke dekking Met ruim 10 kantoren zijn wij landelijk vertegenwoordigd en op die manier kunnen wij regionaal vanuit verschillende vestigingen écht het verschil maken.

Sluit jij je aan bij één van onze ilionx datateams in jouw regio? xgiwjmb Lees hier praktijkervaringen van jouw toekomstige ilionx data collega’s.

Position Summary:

The Dining Services Director, reporting directly to the Executive Director, is responsible for leading all aspects of the community’s dining program, ensuring residents, families, and guests consistently receive nutritious, high-quality meals and exceptional hospitality. This leadership role manages and develops the dining services team, oversees daily kitchen and dining operations, and partners with vendors, community leadership, and regional dining leadership to maintain compliance with food safety, infection control, and budgetary standards. Furthermore, this position requires regular flexibility between cook and server responsibilities. In addition to directing menu planning, food preparation, and special events, the Dining Services Director plays a vital role in enhancing resident satisfaction, supporting marketing initiatives, and fostering a positive, service-oriented culture throughout the community.


Essential Functions:

  • Supervises 10-15 employees in the day-to-day presentation of dining services developed specifically for seniors.
  • Schedule staff on an ongoing basis and provide coverage when unable to find necessary staff coverage.
  • Maintain good communication with all vendors, community leadership, and regional dining services team.
  • Support all catering, room service, special party needs, marketing functions, etc.
  • Responsible for maintaining, ordering, and accounting for food inventories necessary to complete duties and keeping food and supply costs within budget.
  • Instruct all employees on the operation, maintenance, and cleaning of all kitchen equipment.
  • Exhibit thorough knowledge of all food service positions and provide hands-on training to staff.
  • Demonstrate a working knowledge of all dining services shifts and be familiar with individual assignments and resident dining needs.
  • Create recipes that are easy for dietary staff to follow.
  • Handle food in a safe and appropriate manner.
  • Recruit, orientate, and hire new dining service staff.
  • Assist Executive Director with monthly staff in-service meetings as requested and on committees as appointed.
  • Assist with Sales/Marketing procedures to develop and enhance satisfaction levels, as well as participate in resident sales, tours and community needs when required.
  • Securely manage company credit card and file receipts in a timely manner.
  • Maintain appropriate food temperatures by ensuring proper cooling/heating procedures are followed and equipment is working properly.
  • Utilize basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
  • Maintain safety standards as outlined by Cedarhurst guidelines for infection control.
  • Remains current and up to date with all food safety licensing requirements for FDA, state, county, and local authorities along with ensuring all guidelines are adhered to.
  • Work well with others and take direction from management, as well as taking initiative with the capability to engage in conflict intervention and resolution for residents, families, employees, and others as needed.

  • Applicable state/county licensure required.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

AI71 is an industry leader in artificial intelligence, delivering innovative solutions that empower developers, businesses and governments to solve complex challenges. AI71 bridges the gap between advanced AI and real-world impact. The Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team. You’ll play a crucial role in building, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable systems and infrastructure, working closely with development teams to ensure operational efficiency and smooth deployment pipelines.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline development workflows.
  • Build and manage scalable infrastructure for AI model deployment and lifecycle management.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Optimize cloud-based and on-premises resources for scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Manage and fine-tune queuing systems and real-time streaming architectures.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems to ensure uptime and performance.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.
  • Set up comprehensive monitoring for both system metrics and ML model performance.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and post-mortems to improve system reliability.
  • Collaborate with development and QA teams to deploy new features into production seamlessly.
  • Promote best practices in system architecture, security, and performance.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for production system support.
  • Ensure infrastructure complies with security and compliance standards (e.g., SOC2, ISO27001).
  • Securely manage secrets and credentials using tools like Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Skilled in containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience using CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools like Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, or PagerDuty.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with real-time streaming architectures for AI and data applications.

Great Pluses / Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Pulumi.
  • Understanding of service mesh technologies like Istio or Linkerd.
  • Familiarity with database scaling and administration, including VectorDBs, SQL, and NoSQL systems.
  • Previous experience in a high-traffic production environment.

Why AI71:

  • Mission-Driven Work: Work on cutting-edge AI applications with a talented and passionate team, solving real-world challenges in critical sectors.
  • Unparalleled Opportunity: This is a chance to innovate and solve real-world challenges using AI at a company with unique access to world-leading models and resources.
  • Career Growth: We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and significant career growth opportunities as a foundational member of the team.
  • World-Class Environment: Enjoy a flexible working environment and the latest tools & technologies needed to do your best work.

title: Security Software Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Security Software Developer to join the networking device development team behind Evertz IP switch fabric products, including the EXE and NATX, and Evertz SDI router products, including the NEXX and ENX platforms. In this role, you’ll be responsible for ensuring our products meet the security requirements of the NDcPP (Network Device collaborative Protection Profile) under the Common Criteria certification framework. You’ll work across the codebase to implement security features, stay ahead of vulnerabilities, and support the CI/CD infrastructure that keeps the team moving.

Responsibilities

  • Review and interpret security requirements for NDcPP (Common Criteria) certifications, which occur periodically every few years, and translate them into actionable development tasks
  • Implement and update product software to satisfy evolving security certification requirements — including cryptography, certificate management, authentication, audit logging, and access control — through a mix of C/C++ and Python/Bash development, package patching, and configuration changes as needed
  • Harden the embedded Linux environment, including managing firewall rules (iptables), disabling insecure services and defaults, configuring secure boot, and enforcing least-privilege port policies
  • Secure and configure network management protocols such as SSH, SNMPv3, syslog over TLS, NTP authentication, and HTTPS in line with certification requirements
  • Periodically upgrade the embedded Linux OS and its associated packages to maintain security compliance and long-term supportability
  • Regularly monitor CVE reports and security advisories, and address identified vulnerabilities by backporting upstream patches, updating dependent packages, or applying fixes to existing product revisions
  • Contribute to formal security certification documentation, including CC Security Guides, Security Targets, and related evaluation deliverables
  • Develop and maintain utility scripts in Python and Bash to support security workflows, testing, and automation
  • Contribute to the maintenance of the team’s Jenkins CI infrastructure as needed, including updating Jenkins packages and plugins, maintaining build scripts (Python/Bash), and occasional triage of build failures. This responsibility is shared across the team based on workload and availability

Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field
  • 1–2 years of experience with C/C++ development
  • 1–2 years of experience with Python and Bash scripting
  • Ability to read and interpret security standards, protection profiles, or compliance documentation
  • Familiarity with common security concepts such as TLS/SSL, x.509 certificates, authentication mechanisms, and cryptographic protocols
  • Basic understanding of Linux security management, including firewall configuration, service hardening, and user/permission management
  • Familiarity with securing network management protocols (SSH, SNMP, syslog, NTP, HTTPS)
  • Experience tracking CVEs or security advisories and applying upstream patches or fixes
  • Experience with Jenkins or similar CI/CD tools
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail when working with security-sensitive code
  • A willingness to learn new technologies and take ownership of improving existing designs, processes, and tools for the betterment of the product and the team

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with Common Criteria, NDcPP, or FIPS certification processes, including contributing to evaluation documentation
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux build systems (e.g., Buildroot, Yocto) and package management in embedded environments
  • Experience with secure coding practices in C/C++ (memory safety, input validation, privilege management)
  • Awareness of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) concepts and emerging standards
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git, Subversion)
  • CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Linux+, or similar industry certifications

What We Offer

  • Employer funded benefits program
  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Work-Life Balance
  • Employee assistance plan
  • Employee Discount Platform
  • Career Progression
  • Casual Work Environment
  • Social Events and Sports Teams

Location: Markham, Ontario

Hours: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week

Vacancy: This is a newly created position

Salary Range: $60,000 to $85,000 per year, based on experience

About Evertz Microsystems

Evertz is a global leader in broadcast technology, delivering cutting-edge hardware and software solutions that deliver content to television sets, on-demand services, WebTV, IPTV, and mobile devices (like phones and tablets) worldwide. Trusted by major broadcast facilities, telcos, and satellite providers on every continent, we're known for end-to-end innovation that sets the industry standard.

Canadian-headquartered with offices around the world, Evertz has 2,000+ employees and has been recognized as one of Canada's 50 Best Managed Companies — a testament to our commitment to excellence and global impact.

Join a team where your work shapes the future of broadcast and new media industries.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (TypeScript / Web3)
description:
About Us

In partnership with Sony and SBI — two of Japan's largest companies — we are building the infrastructure to bring the world's assets on-chain: Strium, a next-generation DeFi L1 powered by a fully on-chain orderbook exchange, and Startale App, a consumer super-app. Distributed across Tokyo, New York, and Singapore; English-operating; built to a world-class standard.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of the backend systems powering StartaleApp and other products across the Startale ecosystem.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for someone who can own complex backend systems end-to-end - from designing APIs and backend services, to building scalable data pipelines, managing databases, integrating blockchain infrastructure, and operating production systems under real-world load.

We are looking for an engineer who thrives in a startup environment and is comfortable taking responsibility for any part of the backend stack depending on what the product needs. One month you may be building user-facing APIs, another month designing blockchain indexers, optimizing database performance, improving system reliability, or architecting entirely new backend services from scratch.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who has previously built and operated large-scale production systems serving real users at meaningful scale. You should have firsthand experience designing systems that handle high traffic, large datasets, reliability challenges, and the operational complexity that comes with running critical backend infrastructure in production.

You should be excited by solving difficult engineering problems, building systems that scale, and owning critical infrastructure with a high degree of autonomy. You will take ownership of live production systems from your first weeks. This role assumes prior hands-on Web3 backend experience — we are not looking for someone to learn the Web3 side on the job.

You will work closely with product, infrastructure, and protocol teams to build reliable systems that power seamless user experiences across both traditional and blockchain-based applications.

Because our core product is a Web3 wallet, we highly value engineers who understand how decentralized applications work in practice — not just at the protocol level, but also from the perspective of real-world user interactions with wallets, DeFi protocols, and blockchain-based financial systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of backend architecture and implementation across multiple products within the Startale ecosystem.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable production APIs and backend services used by customer-facing applications.
  • Build and operate high-performance distributed systems capable of serving large user bases and handling significant production traffic reliably.
  • Design backend systems with strong focus on scalability, fault tolerance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines, background workers, asynchronous processing systems, and event-driven architectures.
  • Build and maintain blockchain integrations and indexing systems that ingest, process, and serve on-chain data to internal services and user-facing applications.
  • Design efficient database schemas, optimize complex queries, and ensure long-term scalability of data storage systems.
  • Work across both Web2 and Web3 backend infrastructure, integrating traditional backend systems with blockchain protocols and decentralized infrastructure.
  • Diagnose and solve complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, reliability problems, and scaling challenges.
  • Build systems with strong observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational tooling.
  • Continuously improve backend architecture, deployment pipelines, system reliability, and engineering practices.
  • Move quickly, make sound technical decisions independently, and take ownership of delivering production-ready systems.

Requirements

Core Backend Engineering

  • Extensive experience building and operating production backend systems in modern engineering environments.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern backend frameworks (NestJS, Fastify, Express, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of backend architecture, API design, service-oriented architecture, and distributed systems design.
  • Ability to independently design and deliver complex backend systems with minimal oversight.

Large-Scale Systems Experience

  • Proven track record building and operating backend systems serving large numbers of users in production environments.
  • Experience designing systems that operate reliably under high traffic, heavy workloads, and demanding production conditions.
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization, scalability bottlenecks, concurrency, fault tolerance, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Experience operating systems where uptime, consistency, and reliability directly impact end users.
  • Strong operational mindset and experience handling production incidents and scaling challenges in live systems.

Data & Infrastructure

  • Deep expertise with PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, migrations, and production database management.
  • Experience building systems that process large amounts of structured or event-driven data.
  • Strong understanding of observability, logging, monitoring, and service health management.

Web2 + Web3 Engineering

  • Experience building backend systems for modern Web2 applications.
  • Experience integrating with blockchain infrastructure, node APIs, smart contracts, or decentralized protocols.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating blockchain indexing systems, event processing pipelines, or other on-chain data infrastructure (e.g. The Graph, Subsquid, or custom indexers).
  • Good understanding of wallet architecture, transaction lifecycle, signing flows, and blockchain data models.
  • Experience building or integrating backend systems that interact with DeFi protocols.

Strong Plus

  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience with Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging systems.
  • Experience deploying and operating services using Docker and modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contributions to open-source backend, infrastructure, or blockchain tooling projects.
  • Strong understanding of the DeFi ecosystem and hands-on familiarity with products such as decentralized exchanges, lending protocols, staking systems, bridges, or other on-chain financial infrastructure.

What We Value

We care less about specific technologies and more about engineers who can:

  • Take ownership of complex technical problems from design to production.
  • Work comfortably across different parts of the backend stack depending on what the product needs.
  • Build systems that reliably serve large numbers of users and continue operating under scale and production pressure.
  • Make pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving startup environments.
  • Ramp up fast on an existing codebase and deliver in production within weeks.
  • Learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and adapt to changing product requirements.

Why Join Us

  • Build the core infrastructure powering StartaleApp and the broader Startale ecosystem.
  • Work on technically challenging problems spanning backend engineering, distributed systems, and Web3 infrastructure.
  • Join a highly technical startup environment where engineers have significant ownership and direct product impact.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers building ambitious next-generation infrastructure.
  • Competitive compensation, ownership opportunities, and a direct role in shaping the future of Web3 products.

Position Summary:

The Resident Assistant, reporting directly to the Director of Nursing, supports residents in maintaining their dignity, independence, and overall quality of life by providing personal care assistance, companionship, and encouragement in daily activities. This position plays a vital role in promoting the physical, emotional, and social wellbeing of residents through compassionate care, effective communication, and proactive engagement in community life.   • Assist and provide direction to residents regarding their personal care needs, which include but are not limited to, grooming, hygiene, dressing, nutrition, etc.

  • Take and record temperature, blood pressure, pulse and respiration rates, and food and fluid intake and output, as directed.
  • Transport residents or assists residents with walking along with turning or repositioning residents alone or with assistance.
  • Change bed linens, run errands, direct visitors, and answer telephone.
  • Assist with laundry and housekeeping duties.

  • Encourage and assist residents to participate in activities.
  • Listen to and understand the problems of residents and reports observations immediately to the care team as needed.
  • Promote the physical, personal, and emotional wellbeing of each resident and strive to maintain the ultimate goal, which is to return the resident to their maximum level of self-care and independence, when possible.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in common digital tools and applications, including Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Excel, Word), web-based platforms, electronic health record systems, and any HR-related systems as applicable.

Working Conditions:

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to 200 pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer - OpenShift & CI/CD
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, OpenShift, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitOps, Service Mesh, and DevOps automation.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines and containerized application environments across Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms. The role requires strong practical experience in enterprise DevOps environments, automation, microservices security, observability, and cross-functional collaboration.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, manage, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for enterprise application deployments
  • Build and manage deployment pipelines across container technologies including Native Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift
  • Develop and maintain automated CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions
  • Implement and manage Jenkins-based Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Develop and maintain Jenkins Shared Libraries, Pipeline-as-Code, and Groovy scripting for CI/CD automation
  • Implement and manage GitOps-based deployment practices using tools such as ArgoCD
  • Work with development and engineering teams to automate application build, deployment, release, and environment management processes
  • Manage and support multiple application environments across development, testing, staging, and production
  • Implement and maintain Service Mesh solutions within containerized and microservices environments
  • Support secure communication between microservices and understand microservice authentication and authorization mechanisms
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, deploy, configure, and manage different application environments
  • Implement DevOps automation to improve deployment reliability, repeatability, and efficiency
  • Monitor application and platform health and troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and pipeline issues
  • Implement and maintain enterprise logging and monitoring solutions
  • Work with ELK Stack, Prometheus, and Grafana for centralized logging, monitoring, metrics, dashboards, and troubleshooting
  • Support production deployments, incident resolution, performance monitoring, and continuous platform improvements
  • Contribute to DevOps standards, automation frameworks, engineering best practices, and platform reliability initiatives

Required Technical Skills

CI/CD & Automation

  • Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong experience with Jenkins
  • Experience developing Jenkins Shared Libraries
  • Strong understanding of Pipeline-as-Code
  • Hands-on experience with Groovy scripting for Jenkins automation
  • Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions

Kubernetes & OpenShift

  • Strong hands-on experience with Native Kubernetes
  • Strong hands-on experience with Red Hat OpenShift administration and deployments
  • Experience deploying and managing containerized applications across Kubernetes/OpenShift environments
  • Strong understanding of container-based application deployment and orchestration

GitOps

  • Practical experience with GitOps methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with ArgoCD or similar GitOps tools
  • Understanding of automated, declarative application deployment and environment management

Service Mesh & Microservices Security

  • Practical hands-on experience with Service Mesh technologies
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture
  • Strong understanding of microservice authentication and authorization processes
  • Understanding of secure service-to-service communication

Monitoring & Observability

  • Strong understanding of enterprise logging and monitoring solutions
  • Hands-on experience with ELK Stack
  • Hands-on experience with Prometheus
  • Hands-on experience with Grafana
  • Ability to troubleshoot application and platform issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring dashboards

Required Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work across development, testing, operations, security, and infrastructure teams
  • Strong understanding of enterprise DevOps practices and automation
  • Ability to manage multiple environments and deployment pipelines
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong ownership of production stability, deployment quality, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile/DevOps environment

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working in banking or financial services environments
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms
  • Experience with highly available and production-critical applications
  • Exposure to security, compliance, and controlled deployment practices within regulated environments

  • Audit Knowledge: Experience dealing with security audits or customer reviews (like UAE PDPL, ISO 27001, GDPR, or SOC 2).
  • Communication: Ability to clearly explain technical security rules to clients and internal teams.
  • Attention to Detail: Highly organized and precise when handling sensitive documents.

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 6+ years of experience working in data security, data governance, or IT auditing.

title: Program Manager - Sourcing Category Management
description:
Program Manager - Sourcing Category Management

Location: San Diego, CA

Time Type: Full time

Hours:

Variable

The stated pay scale reflects the range that Sharp reasonably expects to pay for this position. The actual pay rate and pay grade for this position will be dependent on a variety of factors, including an applicant’s years of experience, unique skills and abilities, education, alignment with similar internal candidates, marketplace factors, other requirements for the position, and employer business practices.



What You Will Do
This position has a significant level of spend responsibility, oversees and manages approximately $50M-$100M per year of supplies/services with categories of medium-to-high complexity and risk, and will provide strategic decision-support and recommendations to clinical and non-clinical stakeholders to maximize and ensure the value of supplier performance at Sharp HealthCare. Delivers clinical improvement, cost savings, operational efficiencies, and/or added value by leading cross functional stakeholders through fact/evidence-based, data-driven sourcing initiatives with strong market and competitive analysis, creation of leverage, and professional negotiations to secure the best quality, service, and cost to meet Sharp's business needs. Lead the development of sourcing strategies for key projects, utilizing appropriate sourcing tools, aligning key business stakeholder needs, identifying supply alternatives and recommending the sourcing approach, and establishing the project plan/timeline to deliver an effective sourcing solution.

Required Qualifications
  • 7 Years Progressive, sourcing and contracting experience, including extensive experience developing and executing strategic sourcing plans.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's Degree

Other Qualification Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, operations research, materials management, economics, or related discipline required; or 4 years of experience in healthcare supply chain may substitute for degree - REQUIRED
  • Supply chain-related certification is preferred.

Essential Functions
  • Contract Administration
    Maintain a contract calendar for assigned product committees and collaborate with committee chair and Sr. Clinical Consultant to create strategies that enhance clinical outcomes, increase contracted spend, minimize off-contract purchases, and support system-wide efforts to standardize where appropriate and drive market share to preferred suppliers.
    Work closely with Legal Department to analyze contracts and ensure Sharp HealthCare's interests are met.
    Publish and ensure system-wide awareness of Sharp's contract portfolio, driving compliance to committed contracts.
  • Cost Analysis and Control
    Responsible for monitoring category spend and striving to exceeds goals.
    Establish appropriate metrics to monitor expense trends for assigned categories; conducts supply expense variance analysis and identifies the root cause of variances.
    Establish cost savings goals and drives cost savings projects to achieve those goals.
    Validate, track and maintain cost impact of assigned categories' sourcing and contracting activities.
    Perform complex analyses of suppliers, market share, pricing, budgeting, trends, and impacts of contracting decision on a system and entity basis, and other ad hoc analyses for assigned spend category.
  • Customer Satisfaction
    Accepts and offers constructive feedback.
    Consistently communicates in a positive and timely manner with peers, customers and suppliers.
    Demonstrates cooperation, responsiveness and teamwork toward accomplishment of Department goals.
    Excellent phone and person-to-person communication skills.
    Exchanges ideas, information, and messages readily and effectively, as required by the job. Shows cooperation and courtesy in dealing with coworkers, supervisors and other departments.
    Exhibits behaviors that are consistent with Sharp HealthCare customer service expectations.
    Maintains an active relationship with customers by continuously assessing needs, preferences, and levels of satisfaction of our customers. Identifies ways to serve customers more effectively.
    Treats people fairly, equitably and respects other personal opinions.
    Uses initiative to accomplish tasks, resolves problems cooperatively, offers recommended solutions, and works with others to accomplish tasks. Shows willingness to add to the Team.
    Utilizes proper telephone etiquette including promptly answering the phone, identifying oneself and the department, and displaying courtesy at all times. Also includes returning all calls promptly and relaying pertinent information.
  • Sourcing
    Develop and demonstrate an expert knowledge of assigned categories and present an annual overarching category sourcing plan and 3-5 year strategy for assigned categories.
    Communicate to key stakeholders future trends of product categories and key upcoming changes.
    Assess category opportunities by gathering and analyzing spend data, purchasing patterns, competitive position, analysis of supplier/category industry, economics, market conditions, and expiring contracts.
    Effectively interact with internal and external stakeholders to understand their business needs and challenges, and evaluate suppliers on assurance of supply, quality of product, quality of service, total cost of ownership, innovation, and regulatory impacts.
    Lead multi-disciplinary category teams through the sourcing process to drive clinical and process improvement initiatives consistent with Sharp HealthCare's goals and objectives.
    Establish and execute a negotiation strategy. Conduct contract terms and price negotiations with supplier and perform all aspects of the contract process. Communicate with Finance, Legal, internal stakeholders and leadership throughout the contracting process to develop and document final terms and conditions that comply with requirements.
    Work with GPO representatives, as applicable, regarding supplier exceptions to GPO contract language, and collaborate with legal staff to draft the final negotiated contract terms, conditions and exhibits for each contract proposal, securing supplier's authorized signature on the final negotiated contract offers, and meeting with committees to seek contract approval/award.
  • RFPs and Competitive Bidding
    Develop and execute RFP's, analyze and propose sourcing strategies, understand stakeholder needs, gather business requests, and implement and execute agreements when directed.
    Communicate standardized, scheduled reports for analysis and application at multiple levels within the department, as well as throughout the Sharp organization.
    Negotiate supplier contracts and provide in-depth comparisons of competing proposals to present to product committees and supply chain leadership.
    Initiate and lead RFP/RFQ bids and analysis, supplier evaluation, supplier qualification, supplier selection, contract development/execution and negotiations; and use tools and techniques to profile, benchmark, research, and assess supply chain risks and trends to ensure security of supply.
    Develop supplier selection criteria and gain clinical stakeholder alignment; facilitate the committee's review and evaluation of supplier responses and select finalists; effectively communicate the impact of sourcing decisions to stakeholders, management, impacted employees, and suppliers, as appropriate.
  • Other Duties
    Reviews and approves catalog item-adds when applicable.
    Maintain an organized system for retrieval of department files on shared drive, including supplier and contract information.
    Meets with vendors on as-needed basis to review current contract terms, compliance monitoring, failures to supply that may impact compliance and possible improvement options.
    Attend and contribute to related Value Analysis teams to evaluate and improve existing contractual conditions.
    Manage goals and objectives in consultation with Manager/Direct Supervisor.
    Run and resolve Supply Chain related data audits.
    Assist in maintaining contract database integrity through the use of cycled audits and periodic reviews of contract data.
    Participate with new technology or MMIS system testing, etc. as assigned while meeting established deadlines.
    Maintains knowledge of basic data audit techniques and ability to perform audits.
    Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Must possess excellent influencing skills as well as strong interpersonal communication skills for building relationships with internal stakeholders and supplier executives at all levels.
  • Must be a skilled negotiator with a proven ability to move negotiations forward to a supplier's best and final offer in the designated time frame for the project; and must be skilled at presenting in a live environment and achieving agreement with others, with a demonstrated ability to maintain grace under pressure in difficult negotiations.
  • Must possess a solid understanding of strategic sourcing fundamentals and a demonstrated track record of facilitating and executing successful sourcing initiatives; as well as a thorough understanding of contracting methods and procedures, techniques of specification and contract writing, purchasing law, and ethics and have the ability to read, analyze and negotiate high-level contracts.

title: Full Stack Laravel Developer
description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Full Stack Laravel Developer to join our dynamic software development team. As a key contributor to our digital projects, you will architect and maintain scalable web applications, ensuring high performance and seamless user experiences that define the standard of excellence at Vizz Web Solution . This is an ideal opportunity for a passionate developer ready to build innovative software solutions using cutting-edge PHP and frontend technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust web applications using the Laravel framework and PHP to meet client requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams at Vizz Web Solution to define, design, and ship new features for enterprise-grade software.
  • Build and integrate secure RESTful APIs to ensure smooth data communication between backend services and frontend user interfaces.
  • Optimize application performance and scalability, troubleshooting complex issues in both backend and frontend architecture.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following industry best practices and standard MVC design patterns.
  • Manage database schemas and write optimized SQL queries (MySQL/PostgreSQL) to handle large-scale data efficiently.
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by frontend designers with server-side logic using Vue.js, React, or Blade templates.
  • Conduct thorough unit testing (PHPUnit) and debugging to ensure error‑free deployment and superior product quality.
  • Maintain code integrity and organization using version control tools like Git within a collaborative development environment.

title: Product Manager, AI & Analytics
description:
Senior Product Manager, AI & Analytics

Location: Waltham, MA, Massachusetts Remote Work

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Within the Video Security & Access Control (VS&AC) business unit at Motorola Solutions, we are helping solve some of the biggest challenges around safety and physical security by developing advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and products. Avigilon, a Motorola Solutions brand, designs, develops, and manufactures advanced AI, video analytics, network video management software and hardware, and surveillance cameras that help change the way people interact with their security systems.


Job Description

Reporting to the Group Product Manager, AI & Analytics, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for key AI and analytics initiatives across the Avigilon platform. You'll be part of an empowered product team operating with a start-up mindset inside a large enterprise.

Artificial Intelligence is transforming the physical security landscape, and this role is at the center of that evolution. You will bring a proven track record of having shipped AI/ML products at scale, taking complex models out of research and deploying them into production environments serving high-volume, real-world workloads. In this role, you will turn next-generation AI, from computer vision and object detection to Vision-Language Models (VLMs), generative workflows, and agentic AI, into intuitive, high-value user workflows that make our entire end-to-end product ecosystem shine.

Beyond your own initiative areas, you will help shape how the broader video product team integrates intelligence to solve complex security problems for our customers. You will maintain clear ownership over product vision, discovery, user experience, and technical model trade-offs while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure seamless delivery.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Own Strategic AI Product Area(s): Take full ownership of assigned AI and analytics capabilities within the Avigilon platform. Define the vision for your area, set outcomes, run discovery, and drive the multi-quarter roadmap for high-scale AI capabilities in close partnership with AI research and engineering teams.
  • Bridge AI Research & Technical Scale: Engage deeply with AI Platform Engineering and AI Research teams to evaluate technical trade-offs around model accuracy, inference latency, compute-to-serve costs, infrastructure scaling, and edge vs. cloud deployment. Translate cutting-edge AI capabilities into well-framed problem statements and intuitive operator experiences.
  • Lead Continuous Discovery: Run a rigorous market discovery practice. Conduct customer interviews, observe security workflows in the field, analyze usage data, and synthesize findings to ensure AI capabilities solve real operational pain points rather than serving as "technology-first" novelties.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment: Partner with Video Management Software (VMS), Access Control, Appliances, and Devices Product Management teams to ensure AI features feel like unified platform experiences across the entire ecosystem.
  • Define and Own Scale Metrics: Build the measurement framework for your assigned AI capabilities. Instrument your product to track adoption, field accuracy, inference reliability at scale, engagement, and business impact. Use data to validate hypotheses, refine models, and make the case for future investment.
  • Influence Across the Organization & Field Engagement: Work with Sales, Support, Training, and Product Marketing to ensure successful launches, strong feedback loops, and customer enablement. Create technical value propositions, respond to field inquiries, and help align stakeholders around AI priorities.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering software, cloud, or enterprise solutions, with a demonstrated track record of shipping AI/ML-driven products or capabilities at production scale (e.g., serving thousands of active users, processing high-volume streaming data, or managing large-scale inference workloads).
  • Production AI/ML Depth: Deep understanding of computer vision, deep learning, LLMs/VLMs, and analytics workflows, with the technical fluency to engage meaningfully with AI researchers on model deployment, optimization, latency trade-offs, and cost-to-serve at scale.
  • Empowered Product Thinking: Exceptional critical thinker who is decisive, possesses both technical and business acumen, and has a proven track record of taking complex AI products from research/discovery through to commercial deployment.
  • Continuous Discovery Practice: Experience running customer discovery, conducting field interviews, and translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product strategy and clear requirements.
  • Systems & Scale Thinking: Ability to visualize how edge-to-cloud AI implementations interact at scale, balancing model execution on local hardware versus cloud/on-prem compute costs, bandwidth constraints, and system load.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and relationship skills to present product strategy to senior leadership and align cross-functional engineering, hardware, and marketing teams without direct authority.

What Sets You Apart:

  • Large-Scale GenAI or Agentic AI Deployment: Experience launching or scaling products in production that leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), or multi-step AI agents.
  • AI Prototyping: Ability to rapidly stand up AI-generated prototypes to explore possibilities, test hypotheses, and iterate on workflows before engineering build.
  • Security & Computer Vision Domain Knowledge: Prior experience deploying computer vision models or video analytics at scale within physical security, video management systems (VMS), or IoT/hardware environments.
  • Cloud + On-Prem Hybrid Architecture: Experience scaling products that bridge cloud and on-premise deployments, or managing edge-to-cloud model distribution strategies.

Target Base Salary Range: $150,000 - $180,000

  • Proactively manage project scope and schedule, as well as manage risks/issues and related mitigation strategies throughout project execution.

title: Sr. Purchasing Agent
description:
General Kinematics is the premier manufacturer of vibrating equipment for the processing of bulk materials. From vibratory feeders to entire process systems, General Kinematics creates the solutions customers require to process even the most difficult materials.


The Sr. Purchasing Agent is a strategic procurement leader responsible for driving sourcing strategies, supplier performance, and cost optimization initiatives that support company growth and operational excellence. This role serves as a key business partner to engineering, operations, sales and finance, ensuring procurement decisions align with organizational objectives, risk management priorities, and long-term supply continuity.


In addition to managing critical supplier relationships and negotiations, this position provides leadership within the purchasing function, guiding best practices, supporting capability development, and championing continuous improvement.


Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, delivery, and risk while supporting business and operational goals.
  • Analyze and manage material requirements through the MRP system, ensuring alignment with production scheduling and inventory management.
  • Lead supplier relationship management, including performance reviews, capability assessments, and long-term partnership development.
  • Partner closely with the Supplier Quality team to establish and maintain supplier governance processes, including audit programs, performance metrics, and corrective action oversight.
  • Drive commercial negotiations and contracting strategies to achieve sustainable value and mitigate supply chain risk.
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, operations, sales and finance to influence design, planning, and make-versus-buy decisions.
  • Champion cost leadership initiatives, including should-cost analysis, value engineering, and structured cost-reduction programs.
  • Provide procurement leadership on key projects, including early involvement in project planning and new product initiatives.
  • Analyze market dynamics and supply trends to inform sourcing strategies and executive decision-making.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance procurement efficiency, scalability, and data integrity.
  • Mentor and support development of purchasing team members, promoting a high-performance, collaborative team culture.
  • Perform other tactical duties as required to optimize procurement processes such as maintaining data integrity in the ERP system, supporting engineering changes, etc.

title: Regional Director of Operations (KS, NE)
description:
Position Summary:

The Regional Director of Operations (RDO), reporting directly to the Divisional Director of Operations, provides strategic operational leadership to assigned senior living communities. The RDO is responsible for driving performance outcomes, strengthening community leadership teams, ensuring regulatory compliance, optimizing financial operations, and upholding the organization’s standards for resident experience and service excellence. This role serves as a key resource and advisor to Executive Directors, supporting efficient operations, high-quality service delivery, and long-term community success.


This role requires frequent weekly travel across assigned communities and includes an auto and phone allowance.


Why Work for Cedarhurst:

  • At Cedarhurst, our core values guide how we work together and how we care for those we serve. We expect every team member to be passionate, trustworthy, empathetic, positive, respectful, and approachable. Being part of Cedarhurst means making a meaningful difference every day.
  • We believe our team is our greatest strength. That’s why we invest in comprehensive training, as well as opportunities for both personal and professional growth. We’re committed to promoting from within and supporting team members who want to build their careers with us.
  • Cedarhurst offers a competitive benefits package, including medical insurance, life insurance, long-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan with company match (after one year of service) for eligible employees.
  • Work that makes a difference in the lives of our residents and community
  • Access to our St. Louis Home Office, which includes an on-site gym with brand new equipment, personal training, group classes, and stretching sessions (for visiting or office-based team members)
  • Catered lunches and regular team events at our Home Office
  • Auto and phone allowance to support you in a mobile, travel-based role
  • Meaningful opportunities to build relationships with residents, families, and team members across multiple communities

Essential Duties:

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • Assist Executive Directors in assigned communities with development of their management teams, including interviewing, hiring, training, and coaching/counseling.
  • Support Executive Directors in meeting or exceeding budgeted occupancy goals by ensuring communities are always tour-ready, completing post-tour follow-ups, and holding the Director of Sales accountable.
  • Oversee each community’s satisfaction survey process and partner with Executive Directors to achieve the highest possible satisfaction levels.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and confirm each community remains in compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Conduct monthly budget variance reviews with each community.
  • Review each community’s spend-down sheet/DOMO report at least once weekly and communicate variances and resolutions to the DDO in a timely manner.
  • Conduct routine community visits and use site visit checklists. Conduct timely follow-up with the Executive Director and/or other department heads to make sure deficiencies are addressed, working with other departments as needed.
  • Oversee open positions in each assigned community. Ensure each department leader is filling their open positions in a timely manner and with the right candidates. Monitor time-to-fill data and turnover rates in each assigned community.
  • Conduct onboarding and orientation with new Executive Directors thoroughly ensuring that their onboarding experience is positive and informational. Conduct follow-up training when needed.
  • Provide leadership consistent with key servant-leadership principles, including effective listening, empathy, awareness, and persuasion.
  • Ensure that all Executive Directors are following the communication expectations policy, while also adhering to the policy themselves.
  • Educate Executive Directors on using DOMO and related systems to identify opportunities early and implement effective solutions.
  • Perform conflict intervention and resolution for customers, families, employees, and other impacted parties while practicing company mission and core values.
  • Travel as needed, up to four (4) days per week; overnight travel may be required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Education and/or Experience:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field, OR 9+ years of relevant operational leadership experience.
  • Applicable state licensure or certification as required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of senior housing operations experience with proven leadership and organizational skills.
  • Experience supervising Executive Directors and providing operational direction across multiple communities.
  • Must possess clear knowledge of assisted living, memory care, and independent living regulations in all states within the assigned region.
  • Strong understanding of department functions within senior living communities, including housekeeping, resident care, maintenance, dietary, and business office operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and work effectively with older adults.
  • Demonstrated experience in staffing, team development, and retention.
  • Ability to remain calm in stressful situations, adapt to frequent interruptions, and manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong respect for resident rights, confidentiality, and high service standards.
  • Exceptional organizational and project-management skills; self-starter with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills and sound judgment aligned with the company’s mission, values, and safety priorities.
  • High level of customer service, hospitality, curiosity, and professionalism when interacting with residents, families, employees, and visitors.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), internet browsers (Chrome, Edge, Internet Explorer), Welcome Home CRM, and electronic medical record platforms.

Working Conditions:

As part of The Dover Company’s commitment to providing outstanding care and support, the company ensures that staff work under conditions that prioritize safety, collaboration, and professional growth. The conditions listed below define the experience of working in the Home Office or remotely.

  • This position may need to walk or stand for extended periods and move throughout the community, resident apartments, and other areas of the community.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally be required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as climb or balance.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively and identify/interpret written information.
  • This position may need to lift up to fifty (50) pounds independently, and up to two hundred (200) pounds with assistance.
  • Individuals in this position are required to follow all infection prevention and control protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when necessary, to ensure the health and safety of residents, staff, and visitors.
  • This role involves actively participating in all staff activities aimed at fostering teamwork, unity, and morale. The individual will contribute as a collaborative team player, working alongside colleagues to create a supportive and cohesive work environment.
  • Individuals in this position are required to stay current on all training and ongoing education initiatives. They are expected to actively pursue self-improvement and embrace opportunities for continuous learning to enhance their skills and knowledge.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.


Cedarhurst considers the health and safety of its residents, family members, and team members as its highest priorities. All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, participation in required health assessments (such as TB testing or physical evaluations), and the use of designated personal protective equipment (PPE) as required by company policy and applicable law.

title: Senior Back-End Developer
description:
About this position

About Analyticsmart Consulting Inc

Analyticsmart is a boutique analytics firm specializing in the Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry across Canada and the United States. Our mission is to transform data into meaningful, measurable, and actionable insights that drive growth and profitability for businesses.

By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we optimize decision-making and operational efficiency, helping brands gain a competitive advantage.

Founded in 2009, Analyticsmart has built long-standing partnerships with global brands and retailers. With offices in Toronto, Montreal, and New York City, we are a financially disciplined, growth-focused organization scaling into larger enterprise opportunities.

What Sets Us Apart

  • Expansive bonus and incentive structure
  • Prime office locations (Toronto, Montreal, NYC)
  • Exposure to both emerging brands and global enterprises
  • Strong culture of ownership, collaboration, and impact

The Opportunity

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will lead the architecture, development, and optimization of enterprise-grade backend systems powering our analytics, CRM, AI, and merchandising platforms. You will work closely with leadership, product teams, and developers to drive technical strategy, scalability, and innovation across multiple client-facing solutions.

This role requires a highly experienced engineer capable of leading projects, mentoring developers, making key architectural decisions, and contributing to the evolution of AI-driven technologies including image recognition and computer vision solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead the design of server-side systems and backend services powering web and mobile applications.
  • Architect, build, and secure scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs across multiple systems.
  • Lead backend development using Node.js and modern frameworks while driving coding standards and best practices.
  • Design, optimize, and manage relational and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis.
  • Lead architecture discussions, technical planning, and technology decisions.
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
  • Lead testing, debugging, performance optimization, and scalability initiatives.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to prioritize features and guide technical direction.
  • Support platform reliability, automation, and long-term system growth.

Required Qualifications

  • University degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • Strong experience with MySQL, MS SQL Server, and scalable database design.
  • Experience integrating APIs, multiple data sources, and complex backend systems.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Heroku.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows, testing frameworks, and system architecture.
  • Strong leadership, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-assisted development and QA workflows.
  • Automated QA and testing experience.
  • Exposure to Angular or frontend frameworks.
  • Experience supporting mobile applications.
  • Experience working within retail, analytics, or CPG industries.
  • Knowledge of Docker or containerization technologies.

title: HEAD OF PE
description:
Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and Deliver Lessons: Create and implement lesson plans focused on physical fitness, sports, and health education.
  • Teach Sports Rules and Techniques: Instruct students on the rules and strategies of various sports and physical activities.
  • Assess Student Progress: Evaluate students' physical abilities and progress, providing feedback and guidance.
  • Promote Health and Nutrition: Incorporate health and nutrition education into the curriculum.
  • Organize Activities: Oversee physical education activities, including sports tournaments and classes.
  • Ensure Safety: Maintain a safe environment for all physical activities.
  • Communicate with Parents: Keep parents and guardians informed about their children's progress.
  • Stay Updated: Keep abreast of the latest trends and research in physical fitness and education.

ISP Principles


Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding

and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.


Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.


Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.


Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.


Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.

ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Web Project Manager
description:
Floowi connects top LATAM professionals with leading U.S. companies through remote talent solutions. Our mission is to make LATAM the world's premier hub for growth and excellence.

🌟 About our Client:

Our client is a creative and digital marketing agency that partners with organizations across healthcare, wellness, product, retail services, and business professional sectors. Its services span branding and creative direction, content creation, UI/UX design, website development, and digital strategy and performance marketing, including social media, SEO, and PPC.

✍ Short Description:

We’re seeking an experienced Web Project Manager to own the website delivery process from kickoff through development, QA, revisions, and launch. The role serves as the central point of coordination between clients, developers, and designers, ensuring projects stay organized, on schedule, and moving forward. You’ll translate client requests into clear development tasks, coordinate deliverables, identify roadblocks early, and oversee website launches. This is a project ownership role focused on execution and delivery rather than hands-on development or design.

🌎 Location: 100% Remote (LATAM only)

🗣 Language Requirements: Advanced English (C1+)

⏰ Schedule: Full-time, aligned with EST

😀 Start Date: ASAP

💰 Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD

  • Remote-first flexibility. Work from anywhere.

  • PTO and paid U.S. holidays

💼 Responsibilities:

  • Own website projects from kickoff through development, QA, revisions, and launch, keeping timelines, milestones, tasks, and deadlines on track.

  • Coordinate developers and creative teams, ensure team members have the information and assets needed to complete their work, and follow up on deliverables.

  • Communicate directly with clients, gather content, assets, logins, feedback, and approvals, and translate business requests into clear tasks for developers and designers.

  • Review websites throughout development, perform QA, identify missing or incorrect items, and ensure websites function properly across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

  • Coordinate website launches, including domain changes, hosting, DNS, integrations, migrations, and other launch requirements with the development team.

  • Identify roadblocks early, keep projects moving, and provide progress updates to leadership.

💡 Qualifications:

  • Previous experience managing website development projects from kickoff through launch.

  • 3+ years of project management experience preferred, with experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Strong understanding of the website development lifecycle and experience coordinating developers and creative teams.

  • Working knowledge of website platforms and concepts such as WordPress, Elementor, Shopify, WooCommerce, Framer, hosting, domains, DNS, website migrations, staging vs. production, mobile responsiveness, and website QA.

  • Experience working in a marketing or web agency is strongly preferred, along with familiarity with project management and communication software.

📩 If you meet the experience outlined above, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply—our team is excited about your application and will be in touch as soon as possible.
